```
   279→def build_reflect_repair_prompt(
   280→    *,
   281→    triage_input: Any,
   282→    prior_reports: Mapping[str, str],
   283→    repo_root: Path,
   284→    cli_command: str,
   285→    original_report: str,
   286→    missing_ids: list[str],
   287→    duplicate_ids: list[str],
   288→    build_stage_prompt_fn: Callable[..., str],
   289→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   290→) -> str:
   291→    """Build a targeted retry prompt for a reflect report that failed accounting."""
   292→    missing_short = ", ".join(issue_id.rsplit("::", 1)[-1] for issue_id in missing_ids) or "none"
   293→    duplicate_short = (
   294→        ", ".join(issue_id.rsplit("::", 1)[-1] for issue_id in duplicate_ids) or "none"
   295→    )
   296→    base_prompt = build_stage_prompt_fn(
   297→        "reflect",
   298→        triage_input,
   299→        dict(prior_reports),
   300→        repo_root=repo_root,
   301→        mode="output_only",
   302→        cli_command=cli_command,
   303→        stages_data=stages_data,
   304→    )
   305→    return "\n\n".join(
   306→        [
   307→            base_prompt,
   308→            "## Repair Pass",
   309→            "Your previous reflect report failed the exact-hash accounting check.",
   310→            f"Missing hashes: {missing_short}",
   311→            f"Duplicated hashes: {duplicate_short}",
   312→            "Rewrite the FULL reflect report so it passes validation.",
   313→            "Requirements for this repair:",
   314→            "- Start with a `## Coverage Ledger` section.",
   315→            '- Use one ledger line per issue hash: `- abcd1234 -> cluster "name"` or `- abcd1234 -> skip "reason"`.',
   316→            "- Mention every required hash exactly once in that ledger.",
   317→            "- Do not mention hashes anywhere else in the report.",
   318→            "- Preserve the same strategy unless fixing the missing/duplicate hashes forces a small adjustment.",
   319→            "- Output only the corrected reflect report.",
   320→            "## Previous Reflect Report",
   321→            original_report,
   322→        ]
   323→    )
   324→
   325→
   326→def repair_reflect_report_if_needed(
   327→    *,
   328→    report: str,
   329→    triage_input: Any,
   330→    prior_reports: Mapping[str, str],
   331→    repo_root: Path,
   332→    prompts_dir: Path,
   333→    output_dir: Path,
   334→    logs_dir: Path,
   335→    cli_command: str,
   336→    timeout_seconds: int,
   337→    append_run_log: Callable[[str], None],
   338→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   339→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   340→) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
   341→    """Retry reflect once with a targeted repair prompt when accounting is invalid."""
   342→    _cited, missing_ids, duplicate_ids = dependencies.analyze_reflect_issue_accounting(
   343→        report=report,
   344→        valid_ids=set(
   345→            getattr(triage_input, "review_issues", getattr(triage_input, "open_issues", {})).keys()
   346→        ),
   347→    )
   348→    if not missing_ids and not duplicate_ids:
   349→        return report, None
   350→
   351→    print(colorize("  Reflect: repairing missing/duplicate hash accounting...", "yellow"))
   352→    append_run_log(
   353→        "stage-reflect-repair-start "
   354→        f"missing={len(missing_ids)} duplicates={len(duplicate_ids)}"
   355→    )
   356→
   357→    repair_prompt = build_reflect_repair_prompt(
   358→        triage_input=triage_input,
   359→        prior_reports=prior_reports,
   360→        repo_root=repo_root,
   361→        cli_command=cli_command,
   362→        original_report=report,
   363→        missing_ids=missing_ids,
   364→        duplicate_ids=duplicate_ids,
   365→        build_stage_prompt_fn=dependencies.build_stage_prompt,
   366→        stages_data=stages_data,
   367→    )
   368→    repair_prompt_file = prompts_dir / "reflect.repair.md"
   369→    repair_output_file = output_dir / "reflect.repair.raw.txt"
   370→    repair_log_file = logs_dir / "reflect.repair.log"
   371→    safe_write_text(repair_prompt_file, repair_prompt)
   372→    stage_result = dependencies.run_triage_stage(
   373→        prompt=repair_prompt,
   374→        repo_root=repo_root,
   375→        output_file=repair_output_file,
   376→        log_file=repair_log_file,
   377→        timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
   378→    )
   379→    append_run_log(f"stage-reflect-repair-done code={stage_result.exit_code}")
   380→    if not stage_result.ok:
   381→        return None, f"reflect_repair_failed_exit_{stage_result.exit_code}"
   382→
   383→    repaired_report = dependencies.read_stage_output(repair_output_file)
   384→    if not repaired_report:
   385→        return None, "reflect_repair_empty_output"
   386→
   387→    _cited, missing_after, duplicates_after = dependencies.analyze_reflect_issue_accounting(
   388→        report=repaired_report,
   389→        valid_ids=set(
   390→            getattr(triage_input, "review_issues", getattr(triage_input, "open_issues", {})).keys()
   391→        ),
   392→    )
   393→    if missing_after or duplicates_after:
   394→        return None, "reflect_repair_invalid"
   395→
   396→    print(colorize("  Reflect: repair pass fixed issue accounting.", "green"))
   397→    append_run_log("stage-reflect-repair-success")
   398→    return repaired_report, None

   401→def _execute_parallel_stage(
   402→    *,
   403→    context: StageRunContext,
   404→    stage: str,
   405→    handler: StageHandler | None,
   406→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   407→    """Execute optional parallel stage path."""
   408→    if handler is None or handler.run_parallel is None:
   409→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   410→
   411→    parallel_result = handler.run_parallel(context)
   412→    if parallel_result.status == "dry_run":
   413→        return StageExecutionResult(
   414→            status="dry_run",
   415→            payload={"status": "dry_run"},
   416→            used_parallel=True,
   417→        )
   418→
   419→    if parallel_result.ok and parallel_result.merged_output:
   420→        if handler.record_report is not None:
   421→            handler.record_report(parallel_result.merged_output, context.args, context.services)
   422→            return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={}, used_parallel=True)
   423→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   424→
   425→    if parallel_result.ok:
   426→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   427→
   428→    elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - context.stage_start)
   429→    error_reason = parallel_result.reason or "parallel_execution_failed"
   430→    print(colorize(f"  {stage.capitalize()}: parallel execution failed. Aborting.", "red"))
   431→    context.append_run_log(
   432→        f"stage-failed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s reason={error_reason}"
   433→    )
   434→    return StageExecutionResult(
   435→        status="failed",
   436→        payload={
   437→            "status": "failed",
   438→            "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
   439→            "error": error_reason,
   440→        },
   441→        used_parallel=True,
   442→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   443→    )
   444→
   445→
   446→def _failure_result(
   447→    *,
   448→    stage: str,
   449→    elapsed: int | None,
   450→    error: str,
   451→    append_run_log: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
   452→    log_event: str = "stage-failed",
   453→    log_reason: str | None = None,
   454→    printed_message: str | None = None,
   455→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   456→    if printed_message is not None:
   457→        print(colorize(printed_message, "red"))
   458→    if append_run_log is not None:
   459→        log_parts = [f"{log_event} stage={stage}"]
   460→        if elapsed is not None:
   461→            log_parts.append(f"elapsed={elapsed}s")
   462→        log_parts.append(f"reason={log_reason or error}")
   463→        append_run_log(" ".join(log_parts))
   464→    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
   465→        "status": "failed",
   466→        "error": error,
   467→    }
   468→    if elapsed is not None:
   469→        payload["elapsed_seconds"] = elapsed
   470→    return StageExecutionResult(
   471→        status="failed",
   472→        payload=payload,
   473→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   474→    )
   475→

   477→def _build_subprocess_prompt(
   478→    *,
   479→    context: StageRunContext,
   480→    stage: str,
   481→    prompt_mode: PromptMode,
   482→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   483→) -> tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any]]:
   484→    """Build and persist one stage prompt for subprocess execution."""
   485→    stages_data = context.plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {})
   486→    prompt = dependencies.build_stage_prompt(
   487→        stage,
   488→        context.triage_input,
   489→        dict(context.prior_reports),
   490→        repo_root=context.repo_root,
   491→        mode=prompt_mode,
   492→        cli_command=context.cli_command,
   493→        stages_data=stages_data,
   494→    )
   495→    prompt_file = context.prompts_dir / f"{stage}.md"
   496→    safe_write_text(prompt_file, prompt)
   497→    return prompt, stages_data

   499→
   500→def _run_subprocess_stage(
   501→    *,
   502→    context: StageRunContext,
   503→    stage: str,
   504→    prompt: str,
   505→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   506→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   507→    """Run codex subprocess for one stage (or emit dry-run status)."""
   508→    prompt_file = context.prompts_dir / f"{stage}.md"
   509→    if context.dry_run:
   510→        print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: prompt written to {prompt_file}", "cyan"))
   511→        print(colorize("  [dry-run] Would execute codex subprocess.", "dim"))
   512→        return StageExecutionResult(
   513→            status="dry_run",
   514→            payload={"status": "dry_run"},
   515→        )
   516→
   517→    print(colorize(f"\n  Stage {stage}: launching codex subprocess...", "bold"))
   518→    context.append_run_log(f"stage-subprocess-start stage={stage}")
   519→
   520→    output_file = context.output_dir / f"{stage}.raw.txt"
   521→    log_file = context.logs_dir / f"{stage}.log"
   522→    stage_result = dependencies.run_triage_stage(
   523→        prompt=prompt,
   524→        repo_root=context.repo_root,
   525→        output_file=output_file,
   526→        log_file=log_file,
   527→        timeout_seconds=context.timeout_seconds,
   528→    )
   529→
   530→    elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - context.stage_start)
   531→    context.append_run_log(
   532→        "stage-subprocess-done "
   533→        f"stage={stage} code={stage_result.exit_code} elapsed={elapsed}s"
   534→    )
   535→
   536→    if stage_result.ok:
   537→        return StageExecutionResult(
   538→            status="ready",
   539→            payload={},
   540→            output_file=output_file,
   541→            elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   542→        )
   543→
   544→    print(
   545→        colorize(
   546→            "  Stage "
   547→            f"{stage}: codex subprocess failed (exit {stage_result.exit_code}).",
   548→            "red",
   549→        )
   550→    )
   551→    print(colorize(f"  Check log: {log_file}", "dim"))
   552→    print(colorize("  Re-run to resume (confirmed stages are skipped).", "dim"))
   553→    context.append_run_log(
   554→        "stage-failed "
   555→        f"stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s code={stage_result.exit_code}"
   556→    )
   557→    return StageExecutionResult(
   558→        status="failed",
   559→        payload={
   560→            "status": "failed",
   561→            "exit_code": stage_result.exit_code,
   562→            "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
   563→        },
   564→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   565→    )

   567→
   568→def _resolve_subprocess_artifacts(
   569→    subprocess_result: StageExecutionResult,
   570→) -> tuple[Path, int] | None:
   571→    output_file = subprocess_result.output_file
   572→    elapsed = subprocess_result.elapsed_seconds
   573→    if output_file is None or elapsed is None:
   574→        return None
   575→    return output_file, elapsed

   577→
   578→def _record_stage_report_if_needed(
   579→    *,
   580→    context: StageRunContext,
   581→    stage: str,
   582→    handler: StageHandler | None,
   583→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   584→    output_file: Path,
   585→    elapsed: int,
   586→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any],
   587→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   588→    """Record subprocess output for stages that require orchestrator persistence."""
   589→    if handler is None or handler.record_report is None:
   590→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   591→
   592→    report = dependencies.read_stage_output(output_file)
   593→    if not report:
   594→        return _failure_result(
   595→            stage=stage,
   596→            elapsed=elapsed,
   597→            error="empty_stage_output",
   598→            append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   599→            printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: output file was empty after subprocess.",
   600→        )
   601→
   602→    if stage == "reflect":
   603→        report, repair_error = repair_reflect_report_if_needed(
   604→            report=report,
   605→            triage_input=context.triage_input,
   606→            prior_reports=context.prior_reports,
   607→            repo_root=context.repo_root,
   608→            prompts_dir=context.prompts_dir,
   609→            output_dir=context.output_dir,
   610→            logs_dir=context.logs_dir,
   611→            cli_command=context.cli_command,
   612→            timeout_seconds=context.timeout_seconds,
   613→            append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   614→            dependencies=dependencies,
   615→            stages_data=stages_data,
   616→        )
   617→        if repair_error:
   618→            return _failure_result(
   619→                stage=stage,
   620→                elapsed=elapsed,
   621→                error=repair_error,
   622→                append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   623→                printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: repair failed ({repair_error}).",
   624→            )
   625→        if not report:
   626→            return _failure_result(
   627→                stage=stage,
   628→                elapsed=elapsed,
   629→                error="reflect_repair_no_report",
   630→                append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   631→            )
   632→
   633→    handler.record_report(report, context.args, context.services)
   634→    plan_after_record = context.services.load_plan()
   635→    if not stage_report_recorded(plan_after_record, stage):
   636→        return _failure_result(
   637→            stage=stage,
   638→            elapsed=elapsed,
   639→            error="stage_not_recorded",
   640→            append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   641→            log_event="stage-record-failed",
   642→            printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: handler completed but did not persist the stage.",
   643→        )
   644→    context.append_run_log(
   645→        f"stage-recorded stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s mode=orchestrator"
   646→    )
   647→    return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   648→
   649→
   650→def _run_stage_subprocess_path(
   651→    *,
   652→    context: StageRunContext,
   653→    stage: str,
   654→    handler: StageHandler | None,
   655→    prompt_mode: PromptMode,
   656→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   657→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   658→    prompt, stages_data = _build_subprocess_prompt(
   659→        context=context,
   660→        stage=stage,
   661→        prompt_mode=prompt_mode,
   662→        dependencies=dependencies,
   663→    )
   664→    subprocess_result = _run_subprocess_stage(
   665→        context=context,
   666→        stage=stage,
   667→        prompt=prompt,
   668→        dependencies=dependencies,
   669→    )
   670→    if subprocess_result.status != "ready":
   671→        return subprocess_result
   672→
   673→    subprocess_artifacts = _resolve_subprocess_artifacts(subprocess_result)
   674→    if subprocess_artifacts is None:
   675→        return _failure_result(
   676→            stage=stage,
   677→            elapsed=None,
   678→            error="subprocess_output_missing",
   679→        )
   680→    output_file, elapsed = subprocess_artifacts
   681→
   682→    return _record_stage_report_if_needed(
   683→        context=context,
   684→        stage=stage,
   685→        handler=handler,
   686→        dependencies=dependencies,
   687→        output_file=output_file,
   688→        elapsed=elapsed,
   689→        stages_data=stages_data,
   690→    )
   691→
   692→
   693→def execute_stage(
   694→    context: StageRunContext,
   695→    *,
   696→    handlers: Mapping[str, StageHandler],
   697→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   698→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   699→    """Execute one stage and return an explicit stage outcome."""
   700→    stage = context.stage
   701→    handler = handlers.get(stage)
   702→    prompt_mode = handler.prompt_mode if handler is not None else "output_only"
   703→
   704→    preflight_ok, preflight_reason = preflight_stage(
   705→        stage=stage,
   706→        prompt_mode=prompt_mode,
   707→        plan=context.plan,
   708→        triage_input=context.triage_input,
   709→        dry_run=context.dry_run,
   710→        append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   711→        validate_reflect_issue_accounting=dependencies.validate_reflect_issue_accounting,
   712→    )
   713→    if not preflight_ok:
   714→        elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - context.stage_start)
   715→        return _failure_result(
   716→            stage=stage,
   717→            elapsed=elapsed,
   718→            error=preflight_reason or "stage_preflight_failed",
   719→            printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: blocked before launch ({preflight_reason}).",
   720→        )
   721→
   722→    parallel_result = _execute_parallel_stage(
   723→        context=context,
   724→        stage=stage,
   725→        handler=handler,
   726→    )
   727→    if parallel_result.status != "ready":
   728→        return parallel_result
   729→    if parallel_result.used_parallel:
   730→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   731→    return _run_stage_subprocess_path(
   732→        context=context,
   733→        stage=stage,
   734→        handler=handler,
   735→        prompt_mode=prompt_mode,
   736→        dependencies=dependencies,
   737→    )
   738→
   739→
   740→__all__ = [
   741→    "DEFAULT_STAGE_HANDLERS",
   742→    "StageExecutionResult",
   743→    "StageExecutionDependencies",
   744→    "StageHandler",
   745→    "build_reflect_repair_prompt",
   746→    "default_stage_execution_dependencies",
   747→    "execute_stage",
   748→    "preflight_stage",
   749→    "read_stage_output",
   750→    "repair_reflect_report_if_needed",
   751→    "stage_report_recorded",
   752→]
   753→
```

```
    35→def print_not_finalized_message(reason: str) -> None:
    36→    """Emit a consistent next-step message when auto-completion is skipped/blocked."""
    37→    print(colorize(f"\n  Stages complete, triage not finalized ({reason}).", "yellow"))
    38→    print(

    40→            '  Finalize manually: desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "<execution plan>"',
    41→            "dim",
    42→        )
    43→    )
    44→
    45→
    46→def validate_and_confirm_stage(
    47→    *,
    48→    stage: str,
    49→    args: argparse.Namespace,
    50→    services: TriageServices,
    51→    triage_input: Any,
    52→    state: Any,
    53→    repo_root,
    54→    stage_start: float,
    55→    append_run_log,
    56→) -> tuple[bool, dict, str]:
    57→    """Run shared stage validation + confirmation flow."""
    58→    plan = services.load_plan()
    59→
    60→    ok, error_msg = validate_stage(
    61→        stage,
    62→        plan,
    63→        state,
    64→        repo_root,
    65→        triage_input=triage_input,
    66→    )
    67→    if not ok:
    68→        elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - stage_start)
    69→        print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: validation failed: {error_msg}", "red"))
    70→        print(colorize("  Re-run to resume.", "dim"))
    71→        append_run_log(
    72→            f"stage-validation-failed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s error={error_msg}"
    73→        )
    74→        return (
    75→            False,
    76→            {
    77→                "status": "validation_failed",
    78→                "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
    79→                "error": error_msg,
    80→            },
    81→            "",
    82→        )
    83→
    84→    attestation = build_auto_attestation(stage, plan, triage_input)
    85→    confirm_args = argparse.Namespace(
    86→        confirm=stage,
    87→        attestation=attestation,
    88→        state=getattr(args, "state", None),
    89→    )
    90→
    91→    from ..confirmations.router import cmd_confirm_stage
    92→
    93→    cmd_confirm_stage(confirm_args, services=services)
    94→
    95→    plan = services.load_plan()
    96→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
    97→    stages_data = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
    98→    elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - stage_start)
    99→    if stage in stages_data and stages_data[stage].get("confirmed_at"):
   100→        print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: confirmed ({elapsed}s).", "green"))
   101→        append_run_log(f"stage-confirmed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s")
   102→        report = stages_data.get(stage, {}).get("report", "")
   103→        return (
   104→            True,
   105→            {"status": "confirmed", "elapsed_seconds": elapsed},
   106→            report,
   107→        )
   108→
   109→    print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: auto-confirmation did not take effect.", "red"))
   110→    print(colorize("  Re-run to resume.", "dim"))
   111→    append_run_log(f"stage-confirm-failed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s")
   112→    return (
   113→        False,
   114→        {"status": "confirm_failed", "elapsed_seconds": elapsed},
   115→        "",
   116→    )
   117→
   118→
   119→def build_completion_strategy(stages_data: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
   120→    """Derive a completion strategy from stage reports."""
   121→    strategy_parts: list[str] = []
   122→    recorded_stages: list[str] = []
   123→    for stage in STAGES:
   124→        report = str(stages_data.get(stage, {}).get("report", ""))
   125→        if report:
   126→            recorded_stages.append(stage)
   127→            strategy_parts.append(f"[{stage}] {report[:200]}")
   128→    strategy = " ".join(strategy_parts)
   129→    if len(strategy) < 200:
   130→        if recorded_stages:
   131→            stage_list = ", ".join(recorded_stages)
   132→            summary = (
   133→                f"Triage covered {len(recorded_stages)} stage(s): {stage_list}. "
   134→                "Use the recorded stage reports as the execution plan, preserve the "
   135→                "observe and reflect evidence trail, keep organize and enrich changes "
   136→                "aligned with the recorded dispositions, and verify each cluster before completion."
   137→            )
   138→            strategy = f"{strategy} {summary}".strip()
   139→        else:
   140→            strategy = (
   141→                "Triage completed without recorded stage reports. Before completion, capture "
   142→                "the execution order, the cluster or skip decisions that will change plan state, "
   143→                "and the verification steps needed to confirm the resulting queue is correct."
   144→            )
   145→    return strategy
   146→
   147→
   148→def complete_pipeline(
   149→    *,
   150→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   151→    services: TriageServices,
   152→    plan: Mapping[str, Any],
   153→    strategy: str,
   154→    triage_input: Any,
   155→) -> bool:
   156→    """Run the triage completion coordinator and report success."""
   157→    completed_before = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("last_completed_at")
   158→
   159→    print(colorize("\n  Completing triage...", "bold"))
   160→
   161→    attestation = build_auto_attestation("value-check", plan, triage_input)
   162→    complete_args = argparse.Namespace(
   163→        complete=True,
   164→        strategy=strategy[:2000],
   165→        attestation=attestation,
   166→        state=getattr(args, "state", None),
   167→    )
   168→
   169→    from ..stages.completion import _cmd_triage_complete
   170→
   171→    _cmd_triage_complete(complete_args, services=services)
   172→
   173→    completed_after = (
   174→        services.load_plan().get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("last_completed_at")
   175→    )
   176→    return bool(completed_after and completed_after != completed_before)
   177→
   178→
   179→__all__ = [
   180→    "all_stage_results_successful",
   181→    "build_completion_strategy",
   182→    "complete_pipeline",
   183→    "is_full_stage_run",
   184→    "print_not_finalized_message",
   185→    "validate_and_confirm_stage",
   186→]
```

```
1→"""Stage-gate and coverage helpers for triage command handlers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.base.output.terminal import colorize
     6→from desloppify.engine._plan.constants import is_synthetic_id
     7→from desloppify.engine._state.issue_semantics import is_triage_finding
     8→from desloppify.engine.plan_triage import TRIAGE_IDS
     9→
    10→from ..review_coverage import (
    11→    cluster_issue_ids,
    12→    live_active_triage_issue_ids,
    13→    manual_clusters_with_issues,
    14→)
    15→
    16→
    17→def _require_triage_pending(plan: dict, *, action: str) -> bool:
    18→    """Require at least one triage stage ID to be present in queue for an action."""
    19→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    20→    if order & TRIAGE_IDS:
    21→        return True
    22→    print(colorize(f"  No triage stage in the queue — nothing to {action}.", "yellow"))
    23→    return False
    24→
    25→
    26→def _validate_stage_report(
    27→    report: str | None,
    28→    *,
    29→    stage: str,
    30→    min_chars: int,
    31→    missing_guidance: list[str] | None = None,
    32→    short_guidance: list[str] | None = None,
    33→) -> str | None:
    34→    """Validate staged report presence/length and print consistent guidance."""
    35→    if not report:
    36→        print(colorize(f"  --report is required for --stage {stage}.", "red"))
    37→        for line in missing_guidance or []:
    38→            print(colorize(f"  {line}", "dim"))
    39→        return None
    40→    cleaned = report.strip()
    41→    if len(cleaned) < min_chars:
    42→        print(
    43→            colorize(
    44→                f"  Report too short: {len(cleaned)} chars (minimum {min_chars}).",
    45→                "red",
    46→            )
    47→        )
    48→        for line in short_guidance or []:
    49→            print(colorize(f"  {line}", "dim"))
    50→        return None
    51→    return cleaned
    52→
    53→
    54→def unenriched_clusters(plan: dict) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
    55→    """Return clusters with issues that are missing required enrichment.
    56→
    57→    Requirements:
    58→    - Every cluster needs a description and at least one action_step.
    59→    - Small clusters (< 5 issues) need at least 1 action step per issue,
    60→      so each item has a concrete plan. Large clusters (>= 5) just need
    61→      steps overall (cluster-level plan is sufficient).
    62→    """
    63→    gaps: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
    64→    for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
    65→        issue_ids = cluster_issue_ids(cluster)
    66→        if not issue_ids:
    67→            continue
    68→        if cluster.get("auto"):
    69→            continue
    70→        missing: list[str] = []
    71→        if not cluster.get("description"):
    72→            missing.append("description")
    73→        steps = cluster.get("action_steps") or []
    74→        issue_count = len(issue_ids)
    75→        if not steps:
    76→            missing.append("action_steps")
    77→        elif issue_count < 5 and len(steps) < issue_count:
    78→            missing.append(
    79→                f"action_steps (have {len(steps)}, need >= {issue_count} for small cluster)"
    80→            )
    81→        if missing:
    82→            gaps.append((name, missing))
    83→    return gaps
    84→
    85→
    86→def unclustered_review_issues(plan: dict, state: dict | None = None) -> list[str]:
    87→    """Return review issue IDs that aren't in any manual cluster.
    88→
    89→    When *state* is provided, uses open review/concerns issues from state
    90→    (the canonical source). Falls back to scanning queue_order for backwards
    91→    compatibility.
    92→    """
    93→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    94→    clustered_ids: set[str] = set()
    95→    for cluster in clusters.values():
    96→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
    97→            clustered_ids.update(cluster_issue_ids(cluster))
    98→    skipped_ids = {
    99→        fid for fid in (plan.get("skipped", {}) or {}).keys() if isinstance(fid, str)
   100→    }
   101→
   102→    if state is not None:
   103→        review_ids = [
   104→            fid for fid, finding in (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {})).items()
   105→            if finding.get("status") == "open"
   106→            and is_triage_finding(finding)
   107→        ]
   108→        frozen_ids = (plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}) or {}).get("active_triage_issue_ids")
   109→        if isinstance(frozen_ids, list) and frozen_ids:
   110→            frozen_id_set = live_active_triage_issue_ids(plan, state)
   111→            review_ids = [fid for fid in review_ids if fid in frozen_id_set]
   112→    else:
   113→        review_ids = [
   114→            fid for fid in plan.get("queue_order", [])
   115→            if not is_synthetic_id(fid)
   116→            and (fid.startswith("review::") or fid.startswith("concerns::"))
   117→        ]
   118→
   119→    return [
   120→        fid for fid in review_ids
   121→        if fid not in clustered_ids and fid not in skipped_ids
   122→    ]
   123→
   124→
   125→def value_check_targets(plan: dict, state: dict | None = None) -> list[str]:
   126→    """Return the current execution targets that value-check must judge once each."""
   127→    targets = list(manual_clusters_with_issues(plan))
   128→    targets.extend(unclustered_review_issues(plan, state))
   129→    seen: set[str] = set()
   130→    ordered: list[str] = []
   131→    for target in targets:
   132→        if target in seen:
   133→            continue
   134→        seen.add(target)
   135→        ordered.append(target)
   136→    return ordered
   137→
```

```
1→"""Structured evidence parsing and validation for triage stage submissions."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import re
     6→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     7→
     8→
     9→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    10→# Shared constants
    11→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    12→
    13→VERDICT_KEYWORDS = frozenset({
    14→    "genuine",
    15→    "false positive",
    16→    "false-positive",
    17→    "exaggerated",
    18→    "over-engineering",
    19→    "over engineering",
    20→    "not-worth-it",
    21→    "not worth it",
    22→})
    23→
    24→# Permissive path regex — detects whether *any* file path was mentioned.
    25→# NOT used to validate existence (that's enrich-only in validation.enrich_checks).
    26→_EVIDENCE_PATH_RE = re.compile(r"[\w.@-]+/[\w./@-]+\.\w+")
    27→
    28→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    29→# Data classes
    30→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    31→
    32→@dataclass
    33→class EvidenceFailure:
    34→    """A single evidence validation failure."""
    35→
    36→    code: str
    37→    message: str
    38→    blocking: bool = True
    39→
    40→
    41→@dataclass
    42→class ObserveAssessment:
    43→    """A parsed per-issue assessment from an observe report (template format)."""
    44→
    45→    issue_hash: str
    46→    verdict: str  # normalised keyword
    47→    verdict_reasoning: str = ""
    48→    files_read: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    49→    recommendation: str = ""
    50→
    51→
    52→@dataclass
    53→class ObserveEvidence:
    54→    """Parsed observe-report evidence."""
    55→
    56→    entries: list[ObserveAssessment] = field(default_factory=list)
    57→    unparsed_citation_count: int = 0  # hashes cited without a verdict
    58→    has_parseable_ids: bool = True  # False if valid_ids had no hex-hash IDs
    59→
    60→
    61→@dataclass
    62→class DecisionLedger:
    63→    """Parsed keep/tighten/skip coverage from a value-check report."""
    64→
    65→    entries: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    66→    duplicates: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    67→
    68→
    69→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    70→# OBSERVE evidence parsing — structured template format
    71→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    72→
    73→def _normalise_verdict(raw: str) -> str | None:
    74→    """Return a normalised verdict keyword, or None if not recognised."""
    75→    lower = raw.lower().strip()
    76→    for kw in VERDICT_KEYWORDS:
    77→        if kw in lower:
    78→            # Normalise to canonical form
    79→            canonical = kw.replace("-", " ")
    80→            return canonical
    81→    return None
    82→
    83→
    84→def _build_short_map(valid_ids: set[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    85→    """Build short-hash → full-id map from valid issue IDs."""
    86→    short_map: dict[str, str] = {}
    87→    for fid in valid_ids:
    88→        short = fid.rsplit("::", 1)[-1]
    89→        if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{6,}", short):
    90→            short_map[short] = fid
    91→    return short_map
    92→
    93→
    94→def _is_valid_hash(raw_hash: str, short_map: dict[str, str], valid_ids: set[str]) -> bool:
    95→    """Check if a hash is known in either the short map or valid IDs."""
    96→    return raw_hash in short_map or raw_hash in valid_ids
    97→
    98→
    99→# --- YAML-like template parser ---
   100→
   101→# Matches lines like:  - hash: abc12345  or  hash: abc12345
   102→_YAML_HASH_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*-?\s*hash\s*:\s*([0-9a-f]{6,})", re.IGNORECASE)
   103→# Matches lines like:  verdict: genuine  or  verdict: false-positive
   104→_YAML_VERDICT_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*verdict\s*:\s*(.+)", re.IGNORECASE)
   105→# Matches lines like:  verdict_reasoning: some reason
   106→_YAML_REASONING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*verdict_reasoning\s*:\s*(.+)", re.IGNORECASE)
   107→# Matches lines like:  files_read: [src/foo.ts, src/bar.ts]  or  files_read: src/foo.ts
   108→_YAML_FILES_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*files_read\s*:\s*(.+)", re.IGNORECASE)
   109→# Matches lines like:  recommendation: do something
   110→_YAML_RECOMMENDATION_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*recommendation\s*:\s*(.+)", re.IGNORECASE)
   111→
   112→def _parse_yaml_files_field(raw: str) -> list[str]:
   113→    """Parse the files_read field — supports [a, b] list or single path."""
   114→    raw = raw.strip()
   115→    # Strip surrounding brackets
   116→    if raw.startswith("[") and raw.endswith("]"):
   117→        raw = raw[1:-1]
   118→    # Split on commas
   119→    paths = [p.strip().strip("'\"") for p in raw.split(",")]
   120→    return [p for p in paths if p]
   121→
   122→
   123→def _flush_yaml_entry(
   124→    current: dict,
   125→    short_map: dict[str, str],
   126→    valid_ids: set[str],
   127→) -> ObserveAssessment | None:
   128→    """Convert a collected YAML-like entry dict into an ObserveAssessment, or None if invalid."""
   129→    raw_hash = current.get("hash", "").lower()
   130→    if not raw_hash or not _is_valid_hash(raw_hash, short_map, valid_ids):
   131→        return None
   132→    raw_verdict = current.get("verdict", "")
   133→    verdict = _normalise_verdict(raw_verdict)
   134→    if not verdict:
   135→        return None
   136→    return ObserveAssessment(
   137→        issue_hash=raw_hash,
   138→        verdict=verdict,
   139→        verdict_reasoning=current.get("verdict_reasoning", ""),
   140→        files_read=current.get("files_read", []),
   141→        recommendation=current.get("recommendation", ""),
   142→    )
   143→
   144→
   145→def _parse_yaml_template(
   146→    report: str,
   147→    short_map: dict[str, str],
   148→    valid_ids: set[str],
   149→) -> list[ObserveAssessment]:
   150→    """Parse YAML-like template entries from report text."""
   151→    entries: list[ObserveAssessment] = []
   152→    current: dict | None = None
   153→
   154→    for line in report.splitlines():
   155→        m_hash = _YAML_HASH_RE.match(line)
   156→        if m_hash:
   157→            # Flush previous entry
   158→            if current is not None:
   159→                entry = _flush_yaml_entry(current, short_map, valid_ids)
   160→                if entry:
   161→                    entries.append(entry)
   162→            current = {"hash": m_hash.group(1).lower()}
   163→            continue
   164→
   165→        if current is None:
   166→            continue
   167→
   168→        m_verdict = _YAML_VERDICT_RE.match(line)
   169→        if m_verdict:
   170→            current["verdict"] = m_verdict.group(1).strip()
   171→            continue
   172→
   173→        m_reasoning = _YAML_REASONING_RE.match(line)
   174→        if m_reasoning:
   175→            current["verdict_reasoning"] = m_reasoning.group(1).strip()
   176→            continue
   177→
   178→        m_files = _YAML_FILES_RE.match(line)
   179→        if m_files:
   180→            current["files_read"] = _parse_yaml_files_field(m_files.group(1))
   181→            continue
   182→
   183→        m_rec = _YAML_RECOMMENDATION_RE.match(line)
   184→        if m_rec:
   185→            current["recommendation"] = m_rec.group(1).strip()
   186→            continue
   187→
   188→    # Flush final entry
   189→    if current is not None:
   190→        entry = _flush_yaml_entry(current, short_map, valid_ids)
   191→        if entry:
   192→            entries.append(entry)
   193→
   194→    return entries
   195→
   196→
   197→def parse_observe_evidence(report: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> ObserveEvidence:
   198→    """Parse assessment entries from an observe-stage report.
   199→
   200→    Supports the YAML-like template format:
   201→    hash/verdict/verdict_reasoning/files_read/recommendation
   202→    """
   203→    short_map = _build_short_map(valid_ids)
   204→    entries = _parse_yaml_template(report, short_map, valid_ids)
   205→
   206→    # Count hashes that appear in report but weren't parsed as entries
   207→    all_hashes_in_report = set(re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{8,}", report.lower()))
   208→    valid_short_hashes = set(short_map.keys())
   209→    cited_hashes = all_hashes_in_report & valid_short_hashes
   210→    parsed_hashes = {e.issue_hash for e in entries}
   211→    unparsed = len(cited_hashes - parsed_hashes)
   212→
   213→    return ObserveEvidence(
   214→        entries=entries,
   215→        unparsed_citation_count=unparsed,
   216→        has_parseable_ids=bool(short_map),
   217→    )
   218→
   219→
   220→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   221→# OBSERVE evidence validation — field presence only
   222→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   223→
   224→_OBSERVE_TEMPLATE_HINT = (
   225→    "  Required template per issue:\n"
   226→    "    - hash: <hash>\n"
   227→    "      verdict: genuine | false-positive | exaggerated | over-engineering | not-worth-it\n"
   228→    "      verdict_reasoning: <why this verdict>\n"
   229→    "      files_read: [<file paths>]\n"
   230→    "      recommendation: <what to do>"
   231→)
   232→
   233→
   234→def validate_observe_evidence(
   235→    evidence: ObserveEvidence,
   236→    issue_count: int,
   237→) -> list[EvidenceFailure]:
   238→    """Validate parsed observe evidence — field presence only, no quality thresholds."""
   239→    if issue_count == 0:
   240→        return []
   241→
   242→    # If valid_ids contained no hex-hash IDs, verdict parsing is impossible — skip.
   243→    if not evidence.has_parseable_ids:
   244→        return []
   245→
   246→    failures: list[EvidenceFailure] = []
   247→
   248→    if not evidence.entries:
   249→        failures.append(EvidenceFailure(
   250→            code="no_verdicts",
   251→            message=(
   252→                "No per-issue assessment entries found in report.\n"
   253→                "\n"
   254→                f"{_OBSERVE_TEMPLATE_HINT}\n"
   255→                "\n"
   256→                "  Example:\n"
   257→                "    - hash: 34580232\n"
   258→                "      verdict: false-positive\n"
   259→                "      verdict_reasoning: Uses branded string union KnownTaskType\n"
   260→                "      files_read: [src/types/database.ts]\n"
   261→                "      recommendation: No action needed"
   262→            ),
   263→        ))
   264→        return failures
   265→
   266→    # Check field presence — no quality thresholds
   267→    missing_reasoning: list[ObserveAssessment] = []
   268→    missing_files: list[ObserveAssessment] = []
   269→    missing_recommendation: list[ObserveAssessment] = []
   270→
   271→    for entry in evidence.entries:
   272→        if not entry.verdict_reasoning.strip():
   273→            missing_reasoning.append(entry)
   274→        if not entry.files_read:
   275→            missing_files.append(entry)
   276→        if not entry.recommendation.strip():
   277→            missing_recommendation.append(entry)
   278→
   279→    if missing_reasoning:
   280→        examples = "\n".join(
   281→            f"    [{e.issue_hash}] {e.verdict}" for e in missing_reasoning[:5]
   282→        )
   283→        failures.append(EvidenceFailure(
   284→            code="missing_verdict_reasoning",
   285→            message=(
   286→                f"{len(missing_reasoning)} of {len(evidence.entries)} assessment(s) "
   287→                f"have no verdict_reasoning.\n"
   288→                "\n"
   289→                f"{_OBSERVE_TEMPLATE_HINT}\n"
   290→                "\n"
   291→                f"  Entries missing reasoning:\n{examples}"
   292→            ),
   293→        ))
   294→
   295→    if missing_files:
   296→        examples = "\n".join(
   297→            f"    [{e.issue_hash}] {e.verdict}" for e in missing_files[:5]
   298→        )
   299→        failures.append(EvidenceFailure(
   300→            code="missing_files_read",
   301→            message=(
   302→                f"{len(missing_files)} of {len(evidence.entries)} assessment(s) "
   303→                f"have no files_read.\n"
   304→                "\n"
   305→                f"{_OBSERVE_TEMPLATE_HINT}\n"
   306→                "\n"
   307→                f"  Entries missing files_read:\n{examples}"
   308→            ),
   309→        ))
   310→
   311→    if missing_recommendation:
   312→        examples = "\n".join(
   313→            f"    [{e.issue_hash}] {e.verdict}" for e in missing_recommendation[:5]
   314→        )
   315→        failures.append(EvidenceFailure(
   316→            code="missing_recommendation",
   317→            message=(
   318→                f"{len(missing_recommendation)} of {len(evidence.entries)} assessment(s) "
   319→                f"have no recommendation.\n"
   320→                "\n"
   321→                f"{_OBSERVE_TEMPLATE_HINT}\n"
   322→                "\n"
   323→                f"  Entries missing recommendation:\n{examples}"
   324→            ),
   325→        ))
   326→
   327→    return failures
   328→
   329→
   330→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   331→# REFLECT skip-reason validation
   332→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   333→
   334→_SKIP_LINE_RE = re.compile(
   335→    r"(?:skip|dismiss|defer|drop|remove)\s*:\s*\[?([0-9a-f]{6,})\]?\s*[(\-—–:]*\s*(.+)",
   336→    re.IGNORECASE,
   337→)
   338→
   339→
   340→def validate_reflect_skip_evidence(report: str) -> list[EvidenceFailure]:
   341→    """Validate that skip reasons in a reflect report are non-empty."""
   342→    failures: list[EvidenceFailure] = []
   343→    bad_skips: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
   344→
   345→    for line in report.splitlines():
   346→        m = _SKIP_LINE_RE.search(line)
   347→        if not m:
   348→            continue
   349→        issue_hash = m.group(1)
   350→        reason = m.group(2).strip().rstrip(")")
   351→
   352→        # Just check non-empty reason
   353→        if not reason.strip():
   354→            bad_skips.append((issue_hash, reason))
   355→
   356→    if bad_skips:
   357→        failing_examples = "\n".join(
   358→            f'    [{h}] "{r}"' for h, r in bad_skips[:5]
   359→        )
   360→        failures.append(EvidenceFailure(
   361→            code="vague_skip_reason",
   362→            message=(
   363→                f"{len(bad_skips)} skip reason(s) are empty.\n"
   364→                "\n"
   365→                "  Required format:\n"
   366→                "    Skip: [<hash>] (<reason for skipping>)\n"
   367→                "\n"
   368→                f"  Failing skips:\n{failing_examples}"
   369→            ),
   370→        ))
   371→
   372→    return failures
   373→
   374→
   375→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   376→# Cluster-name mention check (organize + sense-check)
   377→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   378→
   379→def validate_report_references_clusters(
   380→    report: str,
   381→    cluster_names: list[str],
   382→) -> list[EvidenceFailure]:
   383→    """Check that at least one cluster name appears in the report."""
   384→    if not cluster_names:
   385→        return []
   386→
   387→    report_lower = report.lower()
   388→    for name in cluster_names:
   389→        if name.lower() in report_lower:
   390→            return []
   391→
   392→    failures: list[EvidenceFailure] = []
   393→    names_str = ", ".join(cluster_names[:5])
   394→    if len(cluster_names) > 5:
   395→        names_str += f" ... ({len(cluster_names)} total)"
   396→    failures.append(EvidenceFailure(
   397→        code="no_cluster_mention",
   398→        message=(
   399→            f"Report references none of the {len(cluster_names)} cluster name(s).\n"
   400→            "\n"
   401→            "  The report must mention at least one cluster by name to prove\n"
   402→            "  awareness of the plan structure.\n"
   403→            "\n"
   404→            f"  Cluster names: {names_str}"
   405→        ),
   406→    ))
   407→    return failures
   408→
   409→
   410→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   411→# File path mention check (sense-check)
   412→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   413→
   414→def validate_report_has_file_paths(report: str) -> list[EvidenceFailure]:
   415→    """Check that at least one file path appears in the report."""
   416→    if _EVIDENCE_PATH_RE.search(report):
   417→        return []
   418→    return [EvidenceFailure(
   419→        code="no_file_paths_in_report",
   420→        message=(
   421→            "Report references no file paths (need at least 1).\n"
   422→            "\n"
   423→            "  The sense-check report must prove code was read. Include specific\n"
   424→            "  file paths and line numbers for verified steps.\n"
   425→            "\n"
   426→            "  Example:\n"
   427→            "    Verified src/services/funds.ts lines 45-67: function signature\n"
   428→            "    matches step description. Effort tag 'small' is accurate."
   429→        ),
   430→    )]
   431→
   432→
   433→_VALUE_LEDGER_RE = re.compile(
   434→    r"^\s*-\s*(?P<target>.+?)\s*->\s*(?P<decision>keep|tighten|skip)\s*$",
   435→    re.IGNORECASE,
   436→)
   437→
   438→
   439→def parse_value_check_decision_ledger(report: str) -> DecisionLedger:
   440→    """Parse `## Decision Ledger` lines from a value-check report."""
   441→    entries: dict[str, str] = {}
   442→    duplicates: list[str] = []
   443→    for line in report.splitlines():
   444→        match = _VALUE_LEDGER_RE.match(line)
   445→        if match is None:
   446→            continue
   447→        target = match.group("target").strip()
   448→        decision = match.group("decision").strip().lower()
   449→        if target in entries:
   450→            duplicates.append(target)
   451→            continue
   452→        entries[target] = decision
   453→    return DecisionLedger(entries=entries, duplicates=duplicates)
   454→
   455→
   456→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   457→# Shared output helpers
   458→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   459→
   460→def format_evidence_failures(
   461→    failures: list[EvidenceFailure],
   462→    *,
   463→    stage_label: str,
   464→) -> str:
   465→    """Format evidence failures into a single rejection message."""
   466→    blocking = [f for f in failures if f.blocking]
   467→    advisory = [f for f in failures if not f.blocking]
   468→    parts: list[str] = []
   469→
   470→    for f in blocking:
   471→        parts.append(f"  REJECTED: {f.message}")
   472→
   473→    for f in advisory:
   474→        parts.append(f"  Warning: {f.message}")
   475→
   476→    return "\n\n".join(parts)
   477→
   478→
   479→def resolve_short_hash_to_full_id(short_hash: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> str | None:
   480→    """Resolve a short hash to a full issue ID using collision-aware resolution.
   481→
   482→    Uses ``_build_id_resolution_maps`` from reflect_accounting to handle
   483→    ambiguous short hashes safely (drops collisions rather than silently
   484→    overwriting).
   485→    """
   486→    from ..validation.reflect_accounting import _build_id_resolution_maps
   487→
   488→    maps = _build_id_resolution_maps(valid_ids)
   489→    # Try direct match first
   490→    if short_hash in valid_ids:
   491→        return short_hash
   492→    # Try collision-aware short hex map
   493→    resolved = maps.short_hex_map.get(short_hash)
   494→    if resolved:
   495→        return resolved
   496→    return None
   497→
```

Here are the complete contents of all five files:

## 1. stage_prompts_instruction_blocks.py

This file contains stage-specific instruction functions that build detailed prompts for each triage stage. The main functions are:

- `_observe_instructions()` - Verify review issues against source code, use subagents per dimension group, provide structured assessments with verdict/reasoning/files_read/recommendation
- `_reflect_instructions()` - Design cluster structure from observe verdicts, create coverage ledger, filter genuine issues, skip non-worthy ones, establish execution sequence
- `_organize_instructions()` - Execute the reflect blueprint, create clusters via CLI, handle false positives/exaggerated issues, skip decisions, set dependencies
- `_enrich_instructions()` - Make steps executor-ready with detailed specifications, use subagents per cluster, ensure 80+ char detail with file paths
- `_sense_check_instructions()` - Two parallel checks: content check (over-engineering, staleness, line numbers, names, counts) and structure check (file overlaps, cascades, circular deps)
- `_value_check_instructions()` - Final beauty/elegance pass, walk queue item-by-item, choose keep/tighten/skip per item, optimize for simplicity over cleverness

These are stored in `_STAGE_INSTRUCTIONS` dict and exported.

## 2. stage_prompts_instruction_shared.py

Shared static text blocks and helper functions for triage prompts:

- Constants: `_STAGES` tuple and `PromptMode` type (literal "self_record" | "output_only")
- Block functions that return strings:
  - `observe_false_positive_guidance()` - Warns about high false-positive rates in review system
  - `observe_verification_checklist()` - Instructions on reading source files and forming verdicts
  - `observe_example_report_quality()` - Examples of good vs lazy observe reports
  - `observe_structured_template()` - YAML template for structured assessments
- Preamble templates for two modes: `_PREAMBLE_SELF_RECORD` (runs CLI commands) and `_PREAMBLE_OUTPUT_ONLY` (analysis only, no mutations)
- `_CLI_REFERENCE_TEMPLATE` - Available desloppify commands for cluster management and investigation
- Public functions: `triage_prompt_preamble()`, `render_cli_reference()`

## 3. stage_prompts_validation.py

Validation requirement text blocks for triage stages:

- Single function `_validation_requirements(stage: str)` that returns validation text per stage:
  - **observe**: 100+ char report, cite 10% of issues (min 5), structured assessments with all fields, 80+ char attestation
  - **reflect**: 100+ char report, mention recurring dimensions, Coverage Ledger section, account for every issue once
  - **organize**: manual clusters with issues, descriptions and steps, all review issues clustered/skipped, dependencies, no 5+ directory scatter
  - **enrich**: 80+ char detail per step with file paths, issue-refs, effort tags, valid paths on disk, no skipped issue refs
  - **sense-check**: re-runs enrich checks, 100+ char report, 80+ char attestation mentioning clusters
  - **value-check**: re-runs enrich/sense-check, Decision Ledger per target, file paths cited, 80+ char attestation

## 4. stage_prompts.py

Main prompt builder for triage stages. Key components:

- Helper functions:
  - `_required_issue_hashes()` - Extract sorted short hashes from review issues
  - `_compact_issue_summary()` - Summary of open issues by dimension, clusters, and deltas
  - `_issue_context_for_stage()` - Returns appropriate issue context per stage (full data for observe/reflect, compact summary for others)
  - `_format_assessments_table()` - Renders structured observe assessments as markdown table
  - `_format_disposition_table()` - Partitions issues into auto-skipped/genuine/actionability-flagged tables
  - `_format_assessment_file_evidence()` - File-level evidence from assessments
  - `_relevant_prior_reports()` - Determines which prior stage reports matter for current stage

- Main functions:
  - `build_stage_prompt()` - Builds complete subagent prompt with preamble, prior reports, issue data, instructions, CLI reference, validation requirements
  - `cmd_stage_prompt()` - CLI command to print current stage prompt from live plan data

## 5. stage_validation.py

Post-subagent validation and auto-attestation for triage runners:

- `EnrichQualityFailure` dataclass - Structured validation failure with code and message
- Stage validators (all return tuple[bool, str]):
  - `_validate_observe_stage()` - Checks report length, citation count, evidence validity
  - `_validate_reflect_stage()` - Checks report length, missing/duplicate issue IDs, citation coverage
  - `_validate_organize_stage()` - Checks manual clusters exist, all issues clustered, cluster operations logged
  - `_validate_enrich_stage()` - Runs enrich quality checks
  - `_validate_sense_check_stage()` - Runs enrich checks, validates file path presence and cluster references
  - `_validate_value_check_stage()` - Validates decision ledger coverage, parses keep/skip/tighten decisions, checks targets
  
- `validate_stage()` - Dispatcher to validate any stage

```python
"""Canonical shared triage workflow labels and command snippets."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("observe", "Analyse issues & spot contradictions"),
    ("reflect", "Form strategy & present to user"),
    ("organize", "Defer contradictions, cluster, & prioritize"),
    ("enrich", "Make steps executor-ready (detail, refs)"),
    ("sense-check", "Verify accuracy, structure & value"),
    ("commit", "Write strategy & confirm"),
)

TRIAGE_RUNNERS: tuple[str, str] = ("codex", "claude")

TRIAGE_CMD_OBSERVE = (
    'desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report '
    '"analysis of themes and root causes..."'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_REFLECT = (
    'desloppify plan triage --stage reflect --report '
    '"comparison against completed work..."'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_ORGANIZE = (
    'desloppify plan triage --stage organize --report '
    '"summary of organization and priorities..."'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_ENRICH = (
    'desloppify plan triage --stage enrich --report '
    '"summary of enrichment work done..."'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_SENSE_CHECK = (
    'desloppify plan triage --stage sense-check --report '
    '"summary of sense-check findings..."'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_COMPLETE = 'desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "execution plan..."'
TRIAGE_CMD_COMPLETE_VERBOSE = (
    "desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "
    '"execution plan with priorities and verification..."'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_CONFIRM_EXISTING = (
    'desloppify plan triage --confirm-existing --note "..." --strategy "..."'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_CREATE = 'desloppify plan cluster create <name> --description "..."'
TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ADD = "desloppify plan cluster add <name> <issue-patterns>"
TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ENRICH = (
    'desloppify plan cluster update <name> --description "..." --steps '
    '"step 1" "step 2"'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ENRICH_COMPACT = (
    'desloppify plan cluster update <name> --description "..." --steps '
    '"step1" "step2"'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_STEPS = (
    'desloppify plan cluster update <name> --steps "step 1" "step 2"'
)
TRIAGE_CMD_RUN_STAGES_CODEX = "desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner codex"
TRIAGE_CMD_RUN_STAGES_CLAUDE = "desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner claude"

_RUNNER_STAGE_NAMES = frozenset(
    stage_name for stage_name, _label in TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS if stage_name != "commit"
)
_MANUAL_STAGE_COMMANDS: dict[str, str] = {
    "observe": TRIAGE_CMD_OBSERVE,
    "reflect": TRIAGE_CMD_REFLECT,
    "organize": TRIAGE_CMD_ORGANIZE,
    "enrich": TRIAGE_CMD_ENRICH,
    "sense-check": TRIAGE_CMD_SENSE_CHECK,
    "commit": TRIAGE_CMD_COMPLETE,
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StagePrerequisite:
    """One required upstream stage for a triage workflow seam."""

    stage_name: str
    require_confirmation: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StageReadiness:
    """Readiness state for one triage stage."""

    name: str
    recorded: bool
    confirmed: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TriageProgress:
    """Canonical stage progression snapshot for display and validation."""

    stages: tuple[StageReadiness, ...]
    current_stage: str | None
    blocked_reason: str | None
    next_command: str | None
    completed_count: int
    confirmed_count: int


TRIAGE_STAGE_PREREQUISITES: dict[str, tuple[StagePrerequisite, ...]] = {
    "observe": (),
    "reflect": (StagePrerequisite("observe"),),
    "organize": (
        StagePrerequisite("observe"),
        StagePrerequisite("reflect"),
    ),
    "enrich": (
        StagePrerequisite("observe"),
        StagePrerequisite("reflect"),
        StagePrerequisite("organize", require_confirmation=True),
    ),
    "sense-check": (
        StagePrerequisite("enrich", require_confirmation=True),
    ),
    "value-check": (
        StagePrerequisite("sense-check", require_confirmation=True),
    ),
    "commit": (
        StagePrerequisite("value-check"),
    ),
}

TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES: dict[str, set[str]] = {
    stage: {prerequisite.stage_name for prerequisite in prerequisites}
    for stage, prerequisites in TRIAGE_STAGE_PREREQUISITES.items()
}

_STAGE_LABEL_BY_NAME = dict(TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS)


def _confirm_stage_command(stage_name: str) -> str:
    return f"desloppify plan triage --confirm {stage_name}"


def _first_unmet_prerequisite(
    stage_name: str,
    recorded: dict[str, bool],
    confirmed: dict[str, bool],
) -> StagePrerequisite | None:
    for prerequisite in TRIAGE_STAGE_PREREQUISITES[stage_name]:
        if not recorded.get(prerequisite.stage_name, False):
            return prerequisite
        if prerequisite.require_confirmation and not confirmed.get(prerequisite.stage_name, False):
            return prerequisite
    return None


def compute_triage_progress(stages_data: dict) -> TriageProgress:
    """Return canonical triage-stage progression for display and validation."""
    stage_map = stages_data if isinstance(stages_data, dict) else {}
    readiness: list[StageReadiness] = []
    recorded: dict[str, bool] = {}
    confirmed: dict[str, bool] = {}

    for stage_name, _label in TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS:
        payload = stage_map.get(stage_name, {})
        is_recorded = isinstance(payload, dict) and stage_name in stage_map
        is_confirmed = bool(payload.get("confirmed_at")) if isinstance(payload, dict) else False
        readiness.append(
            StageReadiness(
                name=stage_name,
                recorded=is_recorded,
                confirmed=is_confirmed,
            )
        )
        recorded[stage_name] = is_recorded
        confirmed[stage_name] = is_confirmed

    current_stage: str | None = None
    blocked_reason: str | None = None
    next_command: str | None = None

    for stage_name, label in TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS:
        if recorded[stage_name]:
            continue
        missing = _first_unmet_prerequisite(stage_name, recorded, confirmed)
        if missing is None:
            current_stage = stage_name
            next_command = triage_manual_stage_command(stage_name)
        else:
            prerequisite_label = _STAGE_LABEL_BY_NAME.get(missing.stage_name, missing.stage_name)
            if missing.require_confirmation and recorded.get(missing.stage_name, False):
                blocked_reason = f"{label} blocked until {prerequisite_label} is confirmed."
                next_command = _confirm_stage_command(missing.stage_name)
            else:
                blocked_reason = f"{label} blocked until {prerequisite_label} is recorded."
                next_command = triage_manual_stage_command(missing.stage_name)
        break

    return TriageProgress(
        stages=tuple(readiness),
        current_stage=current_stage,
        blocked_reason=blocked_reason,
        next_command=next_command,
        completed_count=sum(1 for stage in readiness if stage.recorded),
        confirmed_count=sum(1 for stage in readiness if stage.confirmed),
    )


def triage_run_stages_command(
    *,
    runner: str = "codex",
    only_stages: str | tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Return the canonical staged triage runner command."""
    resolved_runner = str(runner).strip().lower()
    if resolved_runner not in TRIAGE_RUNNERS:
        supported = ", ".join(TRIAGE_RUNNERS)
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported triage runner: {runner!r}. Valid: {supported}")

    command = f"desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner {resolved_runner}"
    if only_stages is None:
        return command

    if isinstance(only_stages, str):
        stages = [only_stages]
    else:
        stages = [str(stage).strip().lower() for stage in only_stages if str(stage).strip()]

    invalid = [stage for stage in stages if stage not in _RUNNER_STAGE_NAMES]
    if invalid:
        supported = ", ".join(sorted(_RUNNER_STAGE_NAMES))
        bad = ", ".join(sorted(set(invalid)))
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported triage stage(s): {bad}. Valid: {supported}")

    return f"{command} --only-stages {','.join(stages)}"


def triage_runner_commands(
    *,
    only_stages: str | tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], tuple[str, str]]:
    """Return the preferred staged-runner commands for Codex and Claude."""
    return (
        ("Codex", triage_run_stages_command(runner="codex", only_stages=only_stages)),
        ("Claude", triage_run_stages_command(runner="claude", only_stages=only_stages)),
    )


def triage_manual_stage_command(stage: str) -> str:
    """Return the manual fallback command for a triage stage."""
    resolved_stage = str(stage).strip().lower()
    if resolved_stage not in _MANUAL_STAGE_COMMANDS:
        supported = ", ".join(sorted(_MANUAL_STAGE_COMMANDS))
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported triage stage: {stage!r}. Valid: {supported}")
    return _MANUAL_STAGE_COMMANDS[resolved_stage]


__all__ = [
    "StagePrerequisite",
    "StageReadiness",
    "TriageProgress",
    "TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES",
    "TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS",
    "TRIAGE_STAGE_PREREQUISITES",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ADD",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_CREATE",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ENRICH",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ENRICH_COMPACT",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_STEPS",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_COMPLETE",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_SENSE_CHECK",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_COMPLETE_VERBOSE",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_CONFIRM_EXISTING",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_ENRICH",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_OBSERVE",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_ORGANIZE",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_REFLECT",
    "TRIAGE_CMD_RUN_STAGES_CLAUDE",

    "TRIAGE_RUNNERS",

    "triage_manual_stage_command",
    "triage_run_stages_command",
    "triage_runner_commands",
]
```

```python
"""Queue/stage mutation helpers for triage workflow."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from desloppify.base.output.terminal import colorize
from desloppify.engine._plan.constants import normalize_queue_workflow_and_triage_prefix
from desloppify.engine.plan_ops import purge_ids
from desloppify.engine.plan_state import PlanModel
from desloppify.engine.plan_triage import TRIAGE_IDS, TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS

from .plan_state_access import ensure_queue_order, ensure_skipped_map

STAGE_ORDER = ["observe", "reflect", "organize", "enrich", "sense-check", "value-check"]


def has_triage_in_queue(plan: PlanModel) -> bool:
    """Return True when any triage stage IDs are currently queued."""
    order = set(ensure_queue_order(plan))
    return bool(order & TRIAGE_IDS)


def clear_triage_stage_skips(plan: PlanModel) -> None:
    """Remove skipped markers for triage stages before reinjection."""
    skipped = ensure_skipped_map(plan)
    for sid in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS:
        skipped.pop(sid, None)


def inject_triage_stages(plan: PlanModel) -> None:
    """Inject the canonical triage stage IDs at the queue front."""
    order = ensure_queue_order(plan)
    clear_triage_stage_skips(plan)
    remaining = [issue_id for issue_id in order if issue_id not in TRIAGE_IDS]
    order[:] = [*remaining, *TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS]
    normalize_queue_workflow_and_triage_prefix(order)


def purge_triage_stage(plan: PlanModel, stage_name: str) -> None:
    """Remove one triage stage workflow item from the plan."""
    purge_ids(plan, [f"triage::{stage_name}"])


def cascade_clear_dispositions(meta: dict[str, Any], from_stage: str) -> None:
    """Reset issue_dispositions when an earlier stage reruns.

    - observe rerun: wipe the entire disposition map (verdicts change)
    - reflect rerun: clear decision/target/decision_source from all entries
      (observe verdicts remain, but reflect decisions are outdated)
    """
    dispositions = meta.get("issue_dispositions")
    if not dispositions:
        return
    if from_stage == "observe":
        meta["issue_dispositions"] = {}
    elif from_stage == "reflect":
        for entry in dispositions.values():
            entry.pop("decision", None)
            entry.pop("target", None)
            entry.pop("decision_source", None)


def cascade_clear_later_confirmations(
    stages: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    from_stage: str,
) -> list[str]:
    """Clear later-stage confirmations after mutating an earlier stage."""
    try:
        idx = STAGE_ORDER.index(from_stage)
    except ValueError:
        return []
    cleared: list[str] = []
    for later in STAGE_ORDER[idx + 1:]:
        if later in stages and stages[later].get("confirmed_at"):
            stages[later].pop("confirmed_at", None)
            stages[later].pop("confirmed_text", None)
            cleared.append(later)
    return cleared


def print_cascade_clear_feedback(
    cleared: list[str],
    stages: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    """Render confirmation-clearing feedback after stage rewrites."""
    if not cleared:
        return
    print(colorize(f"  Cleared confirmations on: {', '.join(cleared)}", "yellow"))
    next_unconfirmed = next(
        (
            stage
            for stage in STAGE_ORDER
            if stage in stages and not stages[stage].get("confirmed_at")
        ),
        None,
    )
    if next_unconfirmed:
        print(
            colorize(
                f"  Re-confirm with: desloppify plan triage --confirm {next_unconfirmed}",
                "dim",
            )
        )


__all__ = [
    "STAGE_ORDER",
    "cascade_clear_dispositions",
    "cascade_clear_later_confirmations",
    "has_triage_in_queue",
    "inject_triage_stages",
    "print_cascade_clear_feedback",
    "purge_triage_stage",
]
```

```python
"""State mutation helpers for triage stage records."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TypedDict

from desloppify.state_io import utc_now

from ..stage_queue import cascade_clear_later_confirmations


class ObserveAssessmentRecord(TypedDict):
    """Persisted observe-stage verdict for one cited issue hash."""

    hash: str
    verdict: str
    verdict_reasoning: str
    files_read: list[str]
    recommendation: str


class ObserveRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
    stage: str
    report: str
    cited_ids: list[str]
    timestamp: str
    issue_count: int
    dimension_names: list[str]
    dimension_counts: dict[str, int]
    assessments: list[ObserveAssessmentRecord]
    confirmed_at: str
    confirmed_text: str


class ReflectRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
    stage: str
    report: str
    cited_ids: list[str]
    timestamp: str
    issue_count: int
    missing_issue_ids: list[str]
    duplicate_issue_ids: list[str]
    recurring_dims: list[str]
    disposition_ledger: list[dict[str, str]]
    confirmed_at: str
    confirmed_text: str


class OrganizeRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
    stage: str
    report: str
    cited_ids: list[str]
    timestamp: str
    issue_count: int
    confirmed_at: str
    confirmed_text: str
    reused_existing_plan: bool
    completion_note: str


class EnrichRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
    stage: str
    report: str
    timestamp: str
    shallow_count: int
    confirmed_at: str
    confirmed_text: str


class SenseCheckRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
    stage: str
    report: str
    timestamp: str
    confirmed_at: str
    confirmed_text: str


class ValueCheckRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
    stage: str
    report: str
    timestamp: str
    confirmed_at: str
    confirmed_text: str


TriageStages = dict[
    str,
    ObserveRecord | ReflectRecord | OrganizeRecord | EnrichRecord | SenseCheckRecord | ValueCheckRecord,
]


def resolve_reusable_report(
    report: str | None,
    existing_stage: dict | ObserveRecord | ReflectRecord | OrganizeRecord | EnrichRecord | SenseCheckRecord | ValueCheckRecord | None,
) -> tuple[str | None, bool]:
    if report:
        return report, False
    if existing_stage and existing_stage.get("report"):
        return existing_stage["report"], True
    return None, False


def record_observe_stage(
    stages: TriageStages,
    *,
    report: str,
    issue_count: int,
    cited_ids: list[str],
    existing_stage: ObserveRecord | None,
    is_reuse: bool,
    assessments: list[ObserveAssessmentRecord] | None = None,
    dimension_names: list[str] | None = None,
    dimension_counts: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> list[str]:
    observe: ObserveRecord = {
        "stage": "observe",
        "report": report,
        "cited_ids": cited_ids,
        "timestamp": utc_now(),
        "issue_count": issue_count,
    }
    if dimension_names is not None:
        observe["dimension_names"] = dimension_names
    if dimension_counts is not None:
        observe["dimension_counts"] = dimension_counts
    if assessments is not None:
        observe["assessments"] = assessments
    if is_reuse and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("confirmed_at"):
        observe["confirmed_at"] = existing_stage["confirmed_at"]
        observe["confirmed_text"] = existing_stage.get("confirmed_text", "")
    stages["observe"] = observe
    cleared = cascade_clear_later_confirmations(stages, "observe")
    if not is_reuse:
        observe.pop("confirmed_at", None)
        observe.pop("confirmed_text", None)
    return cleared


def record_organize_stage(
    stages: TriageStages,
    *,
    report: str,
    issue_count: int,
    existing_stage: OrganizeRecord | None,
    is_reuse: bool,
) -> list[str]:
    organize: OrganizeRecord = {
        "stage": "organize",
        "report": report,
        "cited_ids": [],
        "timestamp": utc_now(),
        "issue_count": issue_count,
    }
    if is_reuse and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("confirmed_at"):
        organize["confirmed_at"] = existing_stage["confirmed_at"]
        organize["confirmed_text"] = existing_stage.get("confirmed_text", "")
    stages["organize"] = organize
    return cascade_clear_later_confirmations(stages, "organize")


def record_enrich_stage(
    stages: TriageStages,
    *,
    report: str,
    shallow_count: int,
    existing_stage: EnrichRecord | None,
    is_reuse: bool,
) -> list[str]:
    enrich: EnrichRecord = {
        "stage": "enrich",
        "report": report,
        "timestamp": utc_now(),
        "shallow_count": shallow_count,
    }
    if is_reuse and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("confirmed_at"):
        enrich["confirmed_at"] = existing_stage["confirmed_at"]
        enrich["confirmed_text"] = existing_stage.get("confirmed_text", "")
    stages["enrich"] = enrich
    return cascade_clear_later_confirmations(stages, "enrich")


def record_sense_check_stage(
    stages: TriageStages,
    *,
    report: str,
    existing_stage: SenseCheckRecord | None,
    is_reuse: bool,
) -> list[str]:
    sense_check: SenseCheckRecord = {
        "stage": "sense-check",
        "report": report,
        "timestamp": utc_now(),
    }
    if is_reuse and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("confirmed_at"):
        sense_check["confirmed_at"] = existing_stage["confirmed_at"]
        sense_check["confirmed_text"] = existing_stage.get("confirmed_text", "")
    stages["sense-check"] = sense_check
    return cascade_clear_later_confirmations(stages, "sense-check")


def record_value_check_stage(
    stages: TriageStages,
    *,
    report: str,
    existing_stage: ValueCheckRecord | None,
    is_reuse: bool,
) -> list[str]:
    value_check: ValueCheckRecord = {
        "stage": "value-check",
        "report": report,
        "timestamp": utc_now(),
    }
    if is_reuse and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("confirmed_at"):
        value_check["confirmed_at"] = existing_stage["confirmed_at"]
        value_check["confirmed_text"] = existing_stage.get("confirmed_text", "")
    stages["value-check"] = value_check
    return cascade_clear_later_confirmations(stages, "value-check")


def record_confirm_existing_completion(
    *,
    stages: TriageStages,
    note: str,
    issue_count: int,
    confirmed_text: str,
) -> None:
    stages["organize"] = {
        "stage": "organize",
        "report": f"[confirmed-existing] {note}",
        "cited_ids": [],
        "timestamp": utc_now(),
        "issue_count": issue_count,
        "confirmed_at": utc_now(),
        "confirmed_text": confirmed_text,
        "reused_existing_plan": True,
        "completion_note": note,
    }


__all__ = [
    "ObserveAssessmentRecord",
    "ObserveRecord",
    "ReflectRecord",
    "TriageStages",
    "record_confirm_existing_completion",
    "record_enrich_stage",
    "record_observe_stage",
    "record_organize_stage",
    "record_sense_check_stage",
    "record_value_check_stage",
    "resolve_reusable_report",
]
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

from .organize import cmd_stage_organize
from .reflect import cmd_stage_reflect
from ..services import TriageServices
from .enrich import cmd_stage_enrich

STAGE_COMMAND_HANDLERS = {

    "reflect": cmd_stage_reflect,
    "organize": cmd_stage_organize,
    "enrich": cmd_stage_enrich,
    "sense-check": cmd_stage_sense_check,

}


def run_stage_command(
    stage: str | None,
    args: argparse.Namespace,
    *,
    services: TriageServices | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """Run one named triage stage command when available."""
    handler = STAGE_COMMAND_HANDLERS.get(stage or "")
    if handler is None:
        return False
    handler(args, services=services)
    return True
```
