   244→
   245→def _validate_value_check_stage(
   246→    plan: dict,
   247→    state: dict,
   248→    repo_root: Path,
   249→    stages: dict,
   250→) -> tuple[bool, str]:
   251→    """Validate recorded value-check content and ledger coverage."""
   252→    if "value-check" not in stages:
   253→        return False, "Value-check stage not recorded."
   254→    report = stages["value-check"].get("report", "")
   255→    if len(report) < 100:
   256→        return False, f"Value-check report too short ({len(report)} chars, need 100+)."
   257→    failures = run_enrich_quality_checks(plan, repo_root, phase_label="value-check")
   258→    if failures:
   259→        return False, failures[0].message
   260→    path_failures = validate_report_has_file_paths(report)
   261→    blocking_pf = [failure for failure in path_failures if failure.blocking]
   262→    if blocking_pf:
   263→        return False, blocking_pf[0].message
   264→    targets = value_check_targets(plan, state)
   265→    parsed = parse_value_check_decision_ledger(report)
   266→    if not parsed.entries:
   267→        return False, "Value-check report missing `## Decision Ledger` entries."
   268→    if parsed.duplicates:
   269→        return False, f"Value-check report duplicates decision targets: {', '.join(parsed.duplicates[:5])}"
   270→    missing = [target for target in targets if target not in parsed.entries]
   271→    if missing:
   272→        return False, f"Value-check report missing decision(s) for: {', '.join(missing[:5])}"
   273→    extras = [target for target in parsed.entries if target not in targets]
   274→    if extras:
   275→        return False, f"Value-check report references non-live target(s): {', '.join(extras[:5])}"
   276→    vc_clusters = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)
   277→    cluster_failures = validate_report_references_clusters(report, vc_clusters)
   278→    blocking_cf = [failure for failure in cluster_failures if failure.blocking]
   279→    if blocking_cf:
   280→        return False, blocking_cf[0].message
   281→    return True, ""

   284→def validate_stage(
   285→    stage: str,
   286→    plan: dict,
   287→    state: dict,
   288→    repo_root: Path,
   289→    *,
   290→    triage_input: TriageInput | None = None,
   291→) -> tuple[bool, str]:
   292→    """Check subagent completed stage correctly. Returns (ok, error_msg)."""
   293→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   294→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   295→    validators = {
   296→        "observe": lambda: _validate_observe_stage(
   297→            stages=stages,
   298→            triage_input=triage_input,
   299→        ),
   300→        "reflect": lambda: _validate_reflect_stage(stages),
   301→        "organize": lambda: _validate_organize_stage(plan, state, stages),
   302→        "enrich": lambda: _validate_enrich_stage(plan, repo_root, stages),
   303→        "sense-check": lambda: _validate_sense_check_stage(plan, state, repo_root, stages),
   304→        "value-check": lambda: _validate_value_check_stage(plan, state, repo_root, stages),
   305→    }
   306→    validator = validators.get(stage)
   307→    if validator is None:
   308→        return False, f"Unknown stage: {stage}"
   309→    return validator()
   310→
   311→
   312→def _validate_required_stages(stages: dict) -> tuple[bool, str]:
   313→    """Validate that all required triage stages are present and confirmed."""
   314→    for required in ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "enrich", "sense-check", "value-check"):
   315→        if required not in stages:
   316→            return False, f"Stage {required} not recorded."
   317→        if not stages[required].get("confirmed_at"):
   318→            return False, f"Stage {required} not confirmed."
   319→    return True, ""
   320→
   321→
   322→def _validate_cluster_dependency_cycles(clusters: dict) -> tuple[bool, str]:
   323→    """Reject self-referential cluster dependencies."""
   324→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   325→        deps = cluster.get("depends_on_clusters", [])
   326→        if name in deps:
   327→            return False, f"Cluster {name} depends on itself."
   328→    return True, ""
   329→
   330→
   331→def _find_all_trivial_clusters(clusters: dict) -> list[str]:
   332→    """Return manual clusters whose action steps are all marked trivial."""
   333→    trivial_clusters: list[str] = []
   334→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   335→        if cluster.get("auto") or not cluster_issue_ids(cluster):
   336→            continue
   337→        steps = cluster.get("action_steps") or []
   338→        if steps and all(
   339→            isinstance(step, dict) and step.get("effort") == "trivial"
   340→            for step in steps
   341→        ):
   342→            trivial_clusters.append(name)
   343→    return trivial_clusters
   344→
   345→
   346→def validate_completion(
   347→    plan: dict,
   348→    state: dict,
   349→    repo_root: Path,
   350→) -> tuple[bool, str]:
   351→    """Validate plan is ready for triage completion. Returns (ok, error_msg)."""
   352→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   353→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   354→
   355→    ok, message = _validate_required_stages(stages)
   356→    if not ok:
   357→        return ok, message
   358→
   359→    open_review_ids = open_review_ids_from_state(state)
   360→    manual = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)
   361→    if not open_review_ids and not manual:
   362→        return True, ""
   363→    if not manual:
   364→        return False, "No manual clusters with issues."
   365→
   366→    gaps = unenriched_clusters(plan)
   367→    if gaps:
   368→        return False, f"{len(gaps)} cluster(s) still need enrichment."
   369→
   370→    unclustered = unclustered_review_issues(plan, state)
   371→    if unclustered:
   372→        return False, f"{len(unclustered)} review issue(s) not in any cluster."
   373→
   374→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   375→    ok, message = _validate_cluster_dependency_cycles(clusters)
   376→    if not ok:
   377→        return ok, message
   378→
   379→    all_trivial_clusters = _find_all_trivial_clusters(clusters)
   380→    if all_trivial_clusters:
   381→        names = ", ".join(sorted(all_trivial_clusters))
   382→        return True, f"Advisory: all action steps are marked trivial in cluster(s): {names}"
   383→
   384→    return True, ""
   385→

   387→def build_auto_attestation(
   388→    stage: str,

   391→) -> str:
   392→    """Generate valid 80+ char attestation referencing real dimensions/cluster names."""
   393→    review_issues = getattr(triage_input, "review_issues", getattr(triage_input, "open_issues", {}))
   394→    if stage == "observe":
   395→        _by_dim, dim_names = observe_dimension_breakdown(triage_input)
   396→        top_dims = dim_names[:3]

   398→        return (

   400→            f"across dimensions including {dims_str}, identifying themes, "

   402→        )
   403→
   404→    if stage == "reflect":
   405→        _by_dim, dim_names = observe_dimension_breakdown(triage_input)
   406→        top_dims = dim_names[:3]
   407→        dims_str = ", ".join(top_dims)
   408→        return (
   409→            f"My strategy accounts for {len(review_issues)} issues "
   410→            f"across dimensions including {dims_str}, comparing against "
   411→            f"resolved history and forming priorities for execution."
   412→        )
   413→
   414→    if stage == "organize":

   416→        if not cluster_names:
   417→            return (

   419→                "so no manual clusters or issue assignments were needed before continuing."
   420→            )
   421→        names_str = ", ".join(cluster_names[:3])
   422→        return (
   423→            f"I have organized all review issues into clusters including "
   424→            f"{names_str}, with descriptions, action steps, and clear "
   425→            f"priority ordering based on root cause analysis."
   426→        )
   427→
   428→    if stage == "enrich":
   429→        cluster_names = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)
   430→        if not cluster_names:
   431→            return (
   432→                "I verified there are zero open review issues in this enrich batch, "
   433→                "so there were no action steps to elaborate before advancing."
   434→            )
   435→        names_str = ", ".join(cluster_names[:3])
   436→        return (
   437→            f"Steps in clusters including {names_str} are executor-ready with "
   438→            f"detail, file paths, issue refs, and effort tags, verified "
   439→            f"against the actual codebase."
   440→        )
   441→
   442→    if stage == "sense-check":
   443→        cluster_names = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)
   444→        if not cluster_names:
   445→            return (
   446→                "I verified there are zero open review issues in this sense-check batch, "
   447→                "so no cluster content or file-path evidence needed additional review."
   448→            )
   449→        names_str = ", ".join(cluster_names[:3])
   450→        return (
   451→            f"Content and structure verified for clusters including {names_str}. "
   452→            f"All step details are factually accurate, cross-cluster dependencies "
   453→            f"are safe, and enrich-level checks pass."
   454→        )
   455→
   456→    if stage == "value-check":
   457→        targets = value_check_targets(plan, getattr(triage_input, "state", None))
   458→        cluster_names = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)
   459→        if not targets:
   460→            return (
   461→                "I verified there were zero live queue targets in this value-check batch, "
   462→                "so no additional keep, tighten, or skip decisions were required."
   463→            )
   464→        names_str = ", ".join((cluster_names or targets)[:3])
   465→        return (
   466→            f"I reviewed each queued item for value, elegance, and avoidable indirection, "
   467→            f"including {names_str}, keeping only work that genuinely improves the codebase."
   468→        )
   469→
   470→    return f"Stage {stage} completed with thorough analysis of all available data and verified against codebase."
   471→

   218→    if stage == "sense-check":
   219→        stages = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {})
   220→        progress = compute_triage_progress(stages)
   221→        if "sense-check" in stages or progress.current_stage == "sense-check":
   222→            return True, None
   223→        reason = "enrich_not_confirmed"
   224→        append_run_log(f"stage-preflight-failed stage={stage} reason={reason}")
   225→        return False, reason
   226→
   227→    if stage == "value-check":
   228→        stages = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {})
   229→        progress = compute_triage_progress(stages)
   230→        if "value-check" in stages or progress.current_stage == "value-check":
   231→            return True, None
   232→        reason = "sense_check_not_confirmed"
   233→        append_run_log(f"stage-preflight-failed stage={stage} reason={reason}")
   234→        return False, reason
   235→
   236→    if stage != "organize":
   237→        return True, None
   238→    stages = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {})
   239→    reflect_report = str(stages.get("reflect", {}).get("report", ""))
   240→    accounting_ok, _cited, missing_ids, duplicate_ids = validate_reflect_issue_accounting(
   241→        report=reflect_report,
   242→        valid_ids=set(
   243→            getattr(triage_input, "review_issues", getattr(triage_input, "open_issues", {})).keys()
   244→        ),
   245→    )
   246→    if not accounting_ok:
   247→        reason_parts: list[str] = []
   248→        if missing_ids:
   249→            reason_parts.append(f"missing={len(missing_ids)}")
   250→        if duplicate_ids:
   251→            reason_parts.append(f"duplicates={len(duplicate_ids)}")
   252→        reason = "reflect_accounting_invalid"
   253→        if reason_parts:
   254→            reason = f"{reason}({' '.join(reason_parts)})"
   255→        append_run_log(f"stage-preflight-failed stage={stage} reason={reason}")
   256→        return False, reason
   257→
   258→    # Self-record stages mutate plan state from within the subagent, so their
   259→    # postconditions cannot be required before launch. The organize command
   260→    # itself validates ledger/disposition alignment when it records the stage.
   261→    if prompt_mode == "self_record":
   262→        return True, None
   263→
   264→    # Output-only organize paths may rely on pre-applied plan mutations.
   265→    ledger_mismatches = validate_organize_against_reflect_ledger(
   266→        plan=dict(plan), stages=stages,
   267→    )
   268→    if ledger_mismatches:
   269→        mismatch_types = set()
   270→        for m in ledger_mismatches:
   271→            mismatch_types.add(m.expected_decision)
   272→        reason = f"reflect_ledger_mismatch(count={len(ledger_mismatches)} types={','.join(sorted(mismatch_types))})"
   273→        append_run_log(f"stage-preflight-failed stage={stage} reason={reason}")
   274→        return False, reason
   275→
   276→    return True, None

   278→
   279→def build_reflect_repair_prompt(
   280→    *,
   281→    triage_input: Any,
   282→    prior_reports: Mapping[str, str],
   283→    repo_root: Path,
   284→    cli_command: str,
   285→    original_report: str,
   286→    missing_ids: list[str],
   287→    duplicate_ids: list[str],
   288→    build_stage_prompt_fn: Callable[..., str],
   289→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   290→) -> str:
   291→    """Build a targeted retry prompt for a reflect report that failed accounting."""
   292→    missing_short = ", ".join(issue_id.rsplit("::", 1)[-1] for issue_id in missing_ids) or "none"
   293→    duplicate_short = (
   294→        ", ".join(issue_id.rsplit("::", 1)[-1] for issue_id in duplicate_ids) or "none"
   295→    )
   296→    base_prompt = build_stage_prompt_fn(
   297→        "reflect",
   298→        triage_input,
   299→        dict(prior_reports),
   300→        repo_root=repo_root,
   301→        mode="output_only",
   302→        cli_command=cli_command,
   303→        stages_data=stages_data,
   304→    )
   305→    return "\n\n".join(
   306→        [
   307→            base_prompt,
   308→            "## Repair Pass",
   309→            "Your previous reflect report failed the exact-hash accounting check.",
   310→            f"Missing hashes: {missing_short}",
   311→            f"Duplicated hashes: {duplicate_short}",
   312→            "Rewrite the FULL reflect report so it passes validation.",
   313→            "Requirements for this repair:",
   314→            "- Start with a `## Coverage Ledger` section.",
   315→            '- Use one ledger line per issue hash: `- abcd1234 -> cluster "name"` or `- abcd1234 -> skip "reason"`.',
   316→            "- Mention every required hash exactly once in that ledger.",
   317→            "- Do not mention hashes anywhere else in the report.",
   318→            "- Preserve the same strategy unless fixing the missing/duplicate hashes forces a small adjustment.",
   319→            "- Output only the corrected reflect report.",
   320→            "## Previous Reflect Report",
   321→            original_report,
   322→        ]
   323→    )
   324→
   325→
   326→def repair_reflect_report_if_needed(
   327→    *,
   328→    report: str,
   329→    triage_input: Any,
   330→    prior_reports: Mapping[str, str],
   331→    repo_root: Path,
   332→    prompts_dir: Path,
   333→    output_dir: Path,
   334→    logs_dir: Path,
   335→    cli_command: str,
   336→    timeout_seconds: int,
   337→    append_run_log: Callable[[str], None],
   338→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   339→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   340→) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
   341→    """Retry reflect once with a targeted repair prompt when accounting is invalid."""
   342→    _cited, missing_ids, duplicate_ids = dependencies.analyze_reflect_issue_accounting(
   343→        report=report,
   344→        valid_ids=set(
   345→            getattr(triage_input, "review_issues", getattr(triage_input, "open_issues", {})).keys()
   346→        ),
   347→    )
   348→    if not missing_ids and not duplicate_ids:
   349→        return report, None
   350→
   351→    print(colorize("  Reflect: repairing missing/duplicate hash accounting...", "yellow"))
   352→    append_run_log(
   353→        "stage-reflect-repair-start "
   354→        f"missing={len(missing_ids)} duplicates={len(duplicate_ids)}"
   355→    )
   356→
   357→    repair_prompt = build_reflect_repair_prompt(
   358→        triage_input=triage_input,
   359→        prior_reports=prior_reports,
   360→        repo_root=repo_root,
   361→        cli_command=cli_command,
   362→        original_report=report,
   363→        missing_ids=missing_ids,
   364→        duplicate_ids=duplicate_ids,
   365→        build_stage_prompt_fn=dependencies.build_stage_prompt,
   366→        stages_data=stages_data,
   367→    )
   368→    repair_prompt_file = prompts_dir / "reflect.repair.md"
   369→    repair_output_file = output_dir / "reflect.repair.raw.txt"
   370→    repair_log_file = logs_dir / "reflect.repair.log"
   371→    safe_write_text(repair_prompt_file, repair_prompt)
   372→    stage_result = dependencies.run_triage_stage(
   373→        prompt=repair_prompt,
   374→        repo_root=repo_root,
   375→        output_file=repair_output_file,
   376→        log_file=repair_log_file,
   377→        timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
   378→    )
   379→    append_run_log(f"stage-reflect-repair-done code={stage_result.exit_code}")
   380→    if not stage_result.ok:
   381→        return None, f"reflect_repair_failed_exit_{stage_result.exit_code}"
   382→
   383→    repaired_report = dependencies.read_stage_output(repair_output_file)
   384→    if not repaired_report:
   385→        return None, "reflect_repair_empty_output"
   386→
   387→    _cited, missing_after, duplicates_after = dependencies.analyze_reflect_issue_accounting(
   388→        report=repaired_report,
   389→        valid_ids=set(
   390→            getattr(triage_input, "review_issues", getattr(triage_input, "open_issues", {})).keys()
   391→        ),
   392→    )
   393→    if missing_after or duplicates_after:
   394→        return None, "reflect_repair_invalid"
   395→
   396→    print(colorize("  Reflect: repair pass fixed issue accounting.", "green"))
   397→    append_run_log("stage-reflect-repair-success")
   398→    return repaired_report, None

   401→def _execute_parallel_stage(
   402→    *,
   403→    context: StageRunContext,
   404→    stage: str,
   405→    handler: StageHandler | None,
   406→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   407→    """Execute optional parallel stage path."""
   408→    if handler is None or handler.run_parallel is None:
   409→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   410→
   411→    parallel_result = handler.run_parallel(context)
   412→    if parallel_result.status == "dry_run":
   413→        return StageExecutionResult(
   414→            status="dry_run",
   415→            payload={"status": "dry_run"},
   416→            used_parallel=True,
   417→        )
   418→
   419→    if parallel_result.ok and parallel_result.merged_output:
   420→        if handler.record_report is not None:
   421→            handler.record_report(parallel_result.merged_output, context.args, context.services)
   422→            return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={}, used_parallel=True)
   423→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   424→
   425→    if parallel_result.ok:
   426→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   427→
   428→    elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - context.stage_start)
   429→    error_reason = parallel_result.reason or "parallel_execution_failed"
   430→    print(colorize(f"  {stage.capitalize()}: parallel execution failed. Aborting.", "red"))
   431→    context.append_run_log(
   432→        f"stage-failed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s reason={error_reason}"
   433→    )
   434→    return StageExecutionResult(
   435→        status="failed",
   436→        payload={
   437→            "status": "failed",
   438→            "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
   439→            "error": error_reason,
   440→        },
   441→        used_parallel=True,
   442→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   443→    )
   444→
   445→
   446→def _failure_result(
   447→    *,
   448→    stage: str,
   449→    elapsed: int | None,
   450→    error: str,
   451→    append_run_log: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
   452→    log_event: str = "stage-failed",
   453→    log_reason: str | None = None,
   454→    printed_message: str | None = None,
   455→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   456→    if printed_message is not None:
   457→        print(colorize(printed_message, "red"))
   458→    if append_run_log is not None:
   459→        log_parts = [f"{log_event} stage={stage}"]
   460→        if elapsed is not None:
   461→            log_parts.append(f"elapsed={elapsed}s")
   462→        log_parts.append(f"reason={log_reason or error}")
   463→        append_run_log(" ".join(log_parts))
   464→    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
   465→        "status": "failed",
   466→        "error": error,
   467→    }
   468→    if elapsed is not None:
   469→        payload["elapsed_seconds"] = elapsed
   470→    return StageExecutionResult(
   471→        status="failed",
   472→        payload=payload,
   473→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   474→    )
   475→

   477→def _build_subprocess_prompt(
   478→    *,
   479→    context: StageRunContext,
   480→    stage: str,
   481→    prompt_mode: PromptMode,
   482→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   483→) -> tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any]]:
   484→    """Build and persist one stage prompt for subprocess execution."""
   485→    stages_data = context.plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {})
   486→    prompt = dependencies.build_stage_prompt(
   487→        stage,
   488→        context.triage_input,
   489→        dict(context.prior_reports),
   490→        repo_root=context.repo_root,
   491→        mode=prompt_mode,
   492→        cli_command=context.cli_command,
   493→        stages_data=stages_data,
   494→    )
   495→    prompt_file = context.prompts_dir / f"{stage}.md"
   496→    safe_write_text(prompt_file, prompt)
   497→    return prompt, stages_data

   499→
   500→def _run_subprocess_stage(
   501→    *,
   502→    context: StageRunContext,
   503→    stage: str,
   504→    prompt: str,
   505→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   506→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   507→    """Run codex subprocess for one stage (or emit dry-run status)."""
   508→    prompt_file = context.prompts_dir / f"{stage}.md"
   509→    if context.dry_run:
   510→        print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: prompt written to {prompt_file}", "cyan"))
   511→        print(colorize("  [dry-run] Would execute codex subprocess.", "dim"))
   512→        return StageExecutionResult(
   513→            status="dry_run",
   514→            payload={"status": "dry_run"},
   515→        )
   516→
   517→    print(colorize(f"\n  Stage {stage}: launching codex subprocess...", "bold"))
   518→    context.append_run_log(f"stage-subprocess-start stage={stage}")
   519→
   520→    output_file = context.output_dir / f"{stage}.raw.txt"
   521→    log_file = context.logs_dir / f"{stage}.log"
   522→    stage_result = dependencies.run_triage_stage(
   523→        prompt=prompt,
   524→        repo_root=context.repo_root,
   525→        output_file=output_file,
   526→        log_file=log_file,
   527→        timeout_seconds=context.timeout_seconds,
   528→    )
   529→
   530→    elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - context.stage_start)
   531→    context.append_run_log(
   532→        "stage-subprocess-done "
   533→        f"stage={stage} code={stage_result.exit_code} elapsed={elapsed}s"
   534→    )
   535→
   536→    if stage_result.ok:
   537→        return StageExecutionResult(
   538→            status="ready",
   539→            payload={},
   540→            output_file=output_file,
   541→            elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   542→        )
   543→
   544→    print(
   545→        colorize(
   546→            "  Stage "
   547→            f"{stage}: codex subprocess failed (exit {stage_result.exit_code}).",
   548→            "red",
   549→        )
   550→    )
   551→    print(colorize(f"  Check log: {log_file}", "dim"))
   552→    print(colorize("  Re-run to resume (confirmed stages are skipped).", "dim"))
   553→    context.append_run_log(
   554→        "stage-failed "
   555→        f"stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s code={stage_result.exit_code}"
   556→    )
   557→    return StageExecutionResult(
   558→        status="failed",
   559→        payload={
   560→            "status": "failed",
   561→            "exit_code": stage_result.exit_code,
   562→            "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
   563→        },
   564→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   565→    )

   567→
   568→def _resolve_subprocess_artifacts(
   569→    subprocess_result: StageExecutionResult,
   570→) -> tuple[Path, int] | None:
   571→    output_file = subprocess_result.output_file
   572→    elapsed = subprocess_result.elapsed_seconds
   573→    if output_file is None or elapsed is None:
   574→        return None
   575→    return output_file, elapsed

   577→
   578→def _record_stage_report_if_needed(
   579→    *,
   580→    context: StageRunContext,
   581→    stage: str,
   582→    handler: StageHandler | None,
   583→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   584→    output_file: Path,
   585→    elapsed: int,
   586→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any],
   587→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   588→    """Record subprocess output for stages that require orchestrator persistence."""
   589→    if handler is None or handler.record_report is None:
   590→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   591→
   592→    report = dependencies.read_stage_output(output_file)
   593→    if not report:
   594→        return _failure_result(
   595→            stage=stage,
   596→            elapsed=elapsed,
   597→            error="empty_stage_output",
   598→            append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   599→            printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: output file was empty after subprocess.",
   600→        )
   601→
   602→    if stage == "reflect":
   603→        report, repair_error = repair_reflect_report_if_needed(
   604→            report=report,
   605→            triage_input=context.triage_input,
   606→            prior_reports=context.prior_reports,
   607→            repo_root=context.repo_root,
   608→            prompts_dir=context.prompts_dir,
   609→            output_dir=context.output_dir,
   610→            logs_dir=context.logs_dir,
   611→            cli_command=context.cli_command,
   612→            timeout_seconds=context.timeout_seconds,
   613→            append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   614→            dependencies=dependencies,
   615→            stages_data=stages_data,
   616→        )
   617→        if repair_error:
   618→            return _failure_result(
   619→                stage=stage,
   620→                elapsed=elapsed,
   621→                error=repair_error,
   622→                append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   623→                printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: repair failed ({repair_error}).",
   624→            )
   625→        if not report:
   626→            return _failure_result(
   627→                stage=stage,
   628→                elapsed=elapsed,
   629→                error="reflect_repair_no_report",
   630→                append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   631→            )
   632→
   633→    handler.record_report(report, context.args, context.services)
   634→    plan_after_record = context.services.load_plan()
   635→    if not stage_report_recorded(plan_after_record, stage):
   636→        return _failure_result(
   637→            stage=stage,
   638→            elapsed=elapsed,
   639→            error="stage_not_recorded",
   640→            append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   641→            log_event="stage-record-failed",
   642→            printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: handler completed but did not persist the stage.",
   643→        )
   644→    context.append_run_log(
   645→        f"stage-recorded stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s mode=orchestrator"
   646→    )
   647→    return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   648→
   649→
   650→def _run_stage_subprocess_path(
   651→    *,
   652→    context: StageRunContext,
   653→    stage: str,
   654→    handler: StageHandler | None,
   655→    prompt_mode: PromptMode,
   656→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   657→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   658→    prompt, stages_data = _build_subprocess_prompt(
   659→        context=context,
   660→        stage=stage,
   661→        prompt_mode=prompt_mode,
   662→        dependencies=dependencies,
   663→    )
   664→    subprocess_result = _run_subprocess_stage(
   665→        context=context,
   666→        stage=stage,
   667→        prompt=prompt,
   668→        dependencies=dependencies,
   669→    )
   670→    if subprocess_result.status != "ready":
   671→        return subprocess_result
   672→
   673→    subprocess_artifacts = _resolve_subprocess_artifacts(subprocess_result)
   674→    if subprocess_artifacts is None:
   675→        return _failure_result(
   676→            stage=stage,
   677→            elapsed=None,
   678→            error="subprocess_output_missing",
   679→        )
   680→    output_file, elapsed = subprocess_artifacts
   681→
   682→    return _record_stage_report_if_needed(
   683→        context=context,
   684→        stage=stage,
   685→        handler=handler,
   686→        dependencies=dependencies,
   687→        output_file=output_file,
   688→        elapsed=elapsed,
   689→        stages_data=stages_data,
   690→    )
   691→
   692→
   693→def execute_stage(
   694→    context: StageRunContext,
   695→    *,
   696→    handlers: Mapping[str, StageHandler],
   697→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   698→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   699→    """Execute one stage and return an explicit stage outcome."""
   700→    stage = context.stage
   701→    handler = handlers.get(stage)
   702→    prompt_mode = handler.prompt_mode if handler is not None else "output_only"
   703→
   704→    preflight_ok, preflight_reason = preflight_stage(
   705→        stage=stage,
   706→        prompt_mode=prompt_mode,
   707→        plan=context.plan,
   708→        triage_input=context.triage_input,
   709→        dry_run=context.dry_run,
   710→        append_run_log=context.append_run_log,
   711→        validate_reflect_issue_accounting=dependencies.validate_reflect_issue_accounting,
   712→    )
   713→    if not preflight_ok:
   714→        elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - context.stage_start)
   715→        return _failure_result(
   716→            stage=stage,
   717→            elapsed=elapsed,
   718→            error=preflight_reason or "stage_preflight_failed",
   719→            printed_message=f"  Stage {stage}: blocked before launch ({preflight_reason}).",
   720→        )
   721→
   722→    parallel_result = _execute_parallel_stage(
   723→        context=context,
   724→        stage=stage,
   725→        handler=handler,
   726→    )
   727→    if parallel_result.status != "ready":
   728→        return parallel_result
   729→    if parallel_result.used_parallel:
   730→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   731→    return _run_stage_subprocess_path(
   732→        context=context,
   733→        stage=stage,
   734→        handler=handler,
   735→        prompt_mode=prompt_mode,
   736→        dependencies=dependencies,
   737→    )
   738→
   739→
   740→__all__ = [
   741→    "DEFAULT_STAGE_HANDLERS",
   742→    "StageExecutionResult",
   743→    "StageExecutionDependencies",
   744→    "StageHandler",
   745→    "build_reflect_repair_prompt",
   746→    "default_stage_execution_dependencies",
   747→    "execute_stage",
   748→    "preflight_stage",
   749→    "read_stage_output",
   750→    "repair_reflect_report_if_needed",
   751→    "stage_report_recorded",
   752→]
   753→

    46→def validate_and_confirm_stage(
    47→    *,
    48→    stage: str,
    49→    args: argparse.Namespace,
    50→    services: TriageServices,
    51→    triage_input: Any,
    52→    state: Any,
    53→    repo_root,
    54→    stage_start: float,
    55→    append_run_log,
    56→) -> tuple[bool, dict, str]:
    57→    """Run shared stage validation + confirmation flow."""
    58→    plan = services.load_plan()
    59→
    60→    ok, error_msg = validate_stage(
    61→        stage,
    62→        plan,
    63→        state,
    64→        repo_root,
    65→        triage_input=triage_input,
    66→    )
    67→    if not ok:
    68→        elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - stage_start)
    69→        print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: validation failed: {error_msg}", "red"))
    70→        print(colorize("  Re-run to resume.", "dim"))
    71→        append_run_log(
    72→            f"stage-validation-failed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s error={error_msg}"
    73→        )
    74→        return (
    75→            False,
    76→            {
    77→                "status": "validation_failed",
    78→                "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
    79→                "error": error_msg,
    80→            },
    81→            "",
    82→        )
    83→
    84→    attestation = build_auto_attestation(stage, plan, triage_input)
    85→    confirm_args = argparse.Namespace(
    86→        confirm=stage,
    87→        attestation=attestation,
    88→        state=getattr(args, "state", None),
    89→    )
    90→
    91→    from ..confirmations.router import cmd_confirm_stage
    92→
    93→    cmd_confirm_stage(confirm_args, services=services)
    94→
    95→    plan = services.load_plan()
    96→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
    97→    stages_data = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
    98→    elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - stage_start)
    99→    if stage in stages_data and stages_data[stage].get("confirmed_at"):
   100→        print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: confirmed ({elapsed}s).", "green"))
   101→        append_run_log(f"stage-confirmed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s")
   102→        report = stages_data.get(stage, {}).get("report", "")
   103→        return (
   104→            True,
   105→            {"status": "confirmed", "elapsed_seconds": elapsed},
   106→            report,
   107→        )
   108→
   109→    print(colorize(f"  Stage {stage}: auto-confirmation did not take effect.", "red"))
   110→    print(colorize("  Re-run to resume.", "dim"))
   111→    append_run_log(f"stage-confirm-failed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s")
   112→    return (
   113→        False,
   114→        {"status": "confirm_failed", "elapsed_seconds": elapsed},
   115→        "",
   116→    )
   117→
   118→
   119→def build_completion_strategy(stages_data: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
   120→    """Derive a completion strategy from stage reports."""
   121→    strategy_parts: list[str] = []
   122→    recorded_stages: list[str] = []
   123→    for stage in STAGES:
   124→        report = str(stages_data.get(stage, {}).get("report", ""))
   125→        if report:
   126→            recorded_stages.append(stage)
   127→            strategy_parts.append(f"[{stage}] {report[:200]}")
   128→    strategy = " ".join(strategy_parts)
   129→    if len(strategy) < 200:
   130→        if recorded_stages:
   131→            stage_list = ", ".join(recorded_stages)
   132→            summary = (
   133→                f"Triage covered {len(recorded_stages)} stage(s): {stage_list}. "
   134→                "Use the recorded stage reports as the execution plan, preserve the "
   135→                "observe and reflect evidence trail, keep organize and enrich changes "
   136→                "aligned with the recorded dispositions, and verify each cluster before completion."
   137→            )
   138→            strategy = f"{strategy} {summary}".strip()
   139→        else:
   140→            strategy = (
   141→                "Triage completed without recorded stage reports. Before completion, capture "
   142→                "the execution order, the cluster or skip decisions that will change plan state, "
   143→                "and the verification steps needed to confirm the resulting queue is correct."
   144→            )
   145→    return strategy
   146→
   147→
   148→def complete_pipeline(
   149→    *,
   150→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   151→    services: TriageServices,
   152→    plan: Mapping[str, Any],
   153→    strategy: str,
   154→    triage_input: Any,
   155→) -> bool:
   156→    """Run the triage completion coordinator and report success."""
   157→    completed_before = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("last_completed_at")
   158→
   159→    print(colorize("\n  Completing triage...", "bold"))
   160→
   161→    attestation = build_auto_attestation("value-check", plan, triage_input)
   162→    complete_args = argparse.Namespace(
   163→        complete=True,
   164→        strategy=strategy[:2000],
   165→        attestation=attestation,
   166→        state=getattr(args, "state", None),
   167→    )
   168→
   169→    from ..stages.completion import _cmd_triage_complete
   170→
   171→    _cmd_triage_complete(complete_args, services=services)
   172→
   173→    completed_after = (
   174→        services.load_plan().get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("last_completed_at")
   175→    )
   176→    return bool(completed_after and completed_after != completed_before)
   177→
   178→
   179→__all__ = [
   180→    "all_stage_results_successful",

   183→    "is_full_stage_run",
   184→    "print_not_finalized_message",
   185→    "validate_and_confirm_stage",
   186→]

   122→def _content_tasks_and_meta(
   123→    *,
   124→    clusters: list[str],
   125→    plan: dict,
   126→    repo_root: Path,
   127→    prompts_dir: Path,
   128→    output_dir: Path,
   129→    logs_dir: Path,
   130→    timeout_seconds: int,
   131→    dry_run: bool,
   132→    policy_text: str,
   133→    content_mode: str,
   134→    cli_command: str,
   135→    log: Callable[[str], None],
   136→) -> tuple[dict[int, Callable[[], TriageStageRunResult]], list[tuple[str, Path]]]:
   137→    tasks: dict[int, Callable[[], TriageStageRunResult]] = {}
   138→    batch_meta: list[tuple[str, Path]] = []
   139→    for i, cluster_name in enumerate(clusters):
   140→        config = _content_batch_config(
   141→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   142→            batch_index=i,
   143→            plan=plan,
   144→            repo_root=repo_root,
   145→            prompts_dir=prompts_dir,
   146→            output_dir=output_dir,
   147→            logs_dir=logs_dir,
   148→            policy_text=policy_text,
   149→            mode=content_mode,
   150→            cli_command=cli_command,
   151→        )
   152→        _write_batch_prompt(config)
   153→        batch_meta.append((config.label, config.output_file))
   154→        if not dry_run:
   155→            tasks[i] = partial(
   156→                run_triage_stage,
   157→                prompt=config.prompt,
   158→                repo_root=repo_root,
   159→                output_file=config.output_file,
   160→                log_file=config.log_file,
   161→                timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
   162→                validate_output_fn=_output_file_has_text,
   163→            )
   164→        print(colorize(f"    Content batch {i + 1}: {cluster_name}", "dim"))
   165→        log(f"sense-check-content batch={i + 1} cluster={cluster_name}")
   166→    return tasks, batch_meta

   169→def _run_parallel_or_fail(
   170→    *,
   171→    tasks: dict[int, Callable[[], TriageStageRunResult]],
   172→    stage_label: str,
   173→    batch_label_fn: Callable[[int], str],
   174→    log: Callable[[str], None],
   175→) -> list[int]:
   176→    return run_parallel_batches(
   177→        tasks=tasks,

   190→) -> list[int]:
   191→    def _content_label(idx: int) -> str:
   192→        if idx < len(clusters):
   193→            return f"content:{clusters[idx]}"
   194→        return f"content:{idx}"
   195→
   196→    return _run_parallel_or_fail(

   209→    print(colorize(f"  Sense-check: {len(failures)} batch(es) failed: {failures}", "red"))
   210→    log(f"sense-check-parallel-failed failures={failures}")
   211→    return TriageStageRunResult(

   217→def _reload_structure_plan(
   218→    *,
   219→    reload_plan: Callable[[], dict] | None,
   220→    log: Callable[[str], None],
   221→) -> dict | None:
   222→    if reload_plan is None:
   223→        return None
   224→    try:
   225→        reloaded = dict(reload_plan())
   226→        log("sense-check-plan-reloaded phase=structure")
   227→        return reloaded
   228→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive fallback
   229→        print(colorize("  Sense-check: failed to reload plan after content updates.", "red"))
   230→        log(f"sense-check-plan-reload-failed error={exc}")
   231→        return None

   234→def _merge_batch_outputs(batch_meta: list[tuple[str, Path]]) -> str:
   235→    parts: list[str] = []
   236→    for label, output_file in batch_meta:
   237→        content = ""
   238→        if output_file.exists():
   239→            try:
   240→                content = output_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
   241→            except OSError:
   242→                content = "(output missing)"
   243→        if not content:
   244→            content = "(no output)"
   245→        parts.append(f"## {label}\n\n{content}")
   246→    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(parts)
   247→
   248→
   249→def run_sense_check(
   250→    *,
   251→    plan: dict,
   252→    repo_root: Path,
   253→    prompts_dir: Path,
   254→    output_dir: Path,
   255→    logs_dir: Path,
   256→    timeout_seconds: int,
   257→    dry_run: bool = False,
   258→    cli_command: str = "desloppify",
   259→    apply_updates: bool = False,
   260→    reload_plan: Callable[[], dict] | None = None,
   261→    append_run_log=None,
   262→) -> TriageStageRunResult:
   263→    """Run sense-check via parallel codex subprocess batches."""
   264→    _log = append_run_log or _noop_log
   265→
   266→    clusters = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)
   267→    total_content = len(clusters)
   268→    total = total_content + 1
   269→    _print_sense_header(total_content, apply_updates=apply_updates, log=_log)
   270→
   271→    policy_result = load_policy_result()
   272→    policy_text = render_policy_block(policy_result.policy)
   273→    if not policy_result.ok:
   274→        print(
   275→            colorize(
   276→                f"  Warning: ignoring malformed project policy ({policy_result.message or 'unknown error'}).",
   277→                "yellow",
   278→            )
   279→        )
   280→    content_mode, structure_mode = _sense_modes(apply_updates=apply_updates)
   281→    content_tasks, batch_meta = _content_tasks_and_meta(
   282→        clusters=clusters,
   283→        plan=plan,
   284→        repo_root=repo_root,
   285→        prompts_dir=prompts_dir,
   286→        output_dir=output_dir,
   287→        logs_dir=logs_dir,
   288→        timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
   289→        dry_run=dry_run,
   290→        policy_text=policy_text,
   291→        content_mode=content_mode,
   292→        cli_command=cli_command,
   293→        log=_log,
   294→    )
   295→    structure_plan = dict(plan)
   296→    structure_config = _structure_batch_config(
   297→        plan=structure_plan,
   298→        repo_root=repo_root,
   299→        prompts_dir=prompts_dir,
   300→        output_dir=output_dir,
   301→        logs_dir=logs_dir,
   302→        mode=structure_mode,
   303→        cli_command=cli_command,
   304→    )
   305→    _write_batch_prompt(structure_config)
   306→    batch_meta.append((structure_config.label, structure_config.output_file))
   307→    print(colorize("    Structure batch: global dependency check", "dim"))
   308→    _log("sense-check-structure batch=global")
   309→
   310→    if dry_run:
   311→        if apply_updates:
   312→            print(colorize("  [dry-run] Would execute sequenced sense-check batches.", "dim"))
   313→        else:
   314→            print(colorize("  [dry-run] Would execute parallel sense-check batches.", "dim"))
   315→        return TriageStageRunResult(exit_code=0, reason="dry_run", dry_run=True)
   316→
   317→    if content_tasks:
   318→        content_failures = _content_failures(tasks=content_tasks, clusters=clusters, log=_log)
   319→        if content_failures:
   320→            return _parallel_failure_result(content_failures, log=_log)
   321→
   322→    if apply_updates and reload_plan is not None:
   323→        reloaded_plan = _reload_structure_plan(reload_plan=reload_plan, log=_log)
   324→        if reloaded_plan is None:
   325→            return TriageStageRunResult(exit_code=1, reason="plan_reload_failed")
   326→        structure_plan = reloaded_plan
   327→        structure_config = _structure_batch_config(
   328→            plan=structure_plan,
   329→            repo_root=repo_root,
   330→            prompts_dir=prompts_dir,
   331→            output_dir=output_dir,
   332→            logs_dir=logs_dir,
   333→            mode=structure_mode,
   334→            cli_command=cli_command,
   335→        )
   336→        _write_batch_prompt(structure_config)
   337→
   338→    structure_tasks: dict[int, Callable[[], TriageStageRunResult]] = {
   339→        0: partial(
   340→            run_triage_stage,
   341→            prompt=structure_config.prompt,
   342→            repo_root=repo_root,
   343→            output_file=structure_config.output_file,
   344→            log_file=structure_config.log_file,
   345→            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
   346→            validate_output_fn=_output_file_has_text,
   347→        )
   348→    }
   349→    structure_failures = _run_parallel_or_fail(
   350→        tasks=structure_tasks,
   351→        stage_label="Sense-check",
   352→        batch_label_fn=lambda _idx: "structure",
   353→        log=_log,
   354→    )
   355→    if structure_failures:
   356→        return _parallel_failure_result(structure_failures, log=_log)
   357→
   358→    merged = _merge_batch_outputs(batch_meta)
   359→    print(colorize(f"  Sense-check: merged {total} batch outputs ({len(merged)} chars).", "green"))
   360→    _log(f"sense-check-parallel-done merged_chars={len(merged)}")
   361→    return TriageStageRunResult(
   362→        exit_code=0,
   363→        merged_output=merged,
   364→    )
   365→
   366→
   367→__all__ = ["run_sense_check"]
   368→

   212→    parts.append(_sense_check_fix_list())
   213→
   214→    if policy_block:
   215→        parts.append(policy_block)
   216→
   217→    parts.append(
   218→        _sense_check_content_apply_block(
   219→            mode=mode,
   220→            cli_command=cli_command,
   221→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   222→        )
   223→    )
   224→    parts.append(_sense_check_content_not_to_do(mode))
   225→
   226→    # Include cluster steps
   227→    parts.append("## Current Steps\n")
   228→    for i, step in enumerate(steps, 1):
   229→        parts.append(_format_cluster_step(i, step))
   230→
   231→    parts.append(_sense_check_content_output_block(mode))
   232→
   233→    return "\n\n".join(parts)
   234→
   235→
   236→def build_sense_check_structure_prompt(
   237→    *,
   238→    plan: dict,
   239→    repo_root: Path,
   240→    mode: str = "output_only",
   241→    cli_command: str = "desloppify",
   242→) -> str:
   243→    """Build a structure-verification prompt for cross-cluster dependency checking."""
   244→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   245→
   246→    parts: list[str] = []
   247→    parts.append(
   248→        "You are checking cross-cluster dependencies for the entire triage plan.\n"
   249→        f"Repo root: {repo_root}"
   250→    )
   251→
   252→    parts.append(
   253→        "## Your job\n"
   254→        "Build a file-touch graph: for each cluster, which files do its steps reference?\n"
   255→        "Then check for unsafe relationships between clusters.\n"
   256→    )
   257→
   258→    parts.append(
   259→        "## What to check and fix\n"
   260→        "1. SHARED FILES: If cluster A and cluster B both have steps touching the same file,\n"
   261→        "   and neither depends on the other → report which dependency edge should be added.\n"
   262→        "2. MISSING CASCADE: If a step renames/removes a function or export, check whether\n"
   263→        "   any other file imports it. If those importers aren't covered by any step in any\n"
   264→        "   cluster → report the cascade step that should be added.\n"
   265→        "   Include the cluster name, affected importers, and issue hash in your report.\n"
   266→        "3. CIRCULAR DEPS: If adding a dependency would create a cycle, flag it in your report\n"
   267→        "   instead of adding it.\n"
   268→    )
   269→
   270→    structure_apply = _sense_check_structure_apply_block(
   271→        mode=mode,
   272→        cli_command=cli_command,
   273→    )
   274→    if structure_apply:
   275→        parts.append(structure_apply)
   276→    parts.append(_sense_check_structure_not_to_do(mode))
   277→
   278→    # Include all clusters with their steps and dependencies
   279→    parts.append("## Clusters\n")
   280→    for name, c in sorted(clusters.items()):
   281→        if c.get("auto"):
   282→            continue
   283→        parts.extend(_format_structure_cluster(name, c))
   284→
   285→    parts.append(_sense_check_structure_output_block(mode))
   286→
   287→    return "\n\n".join(parts)
   288→
   289→
   290→__all__ = [
   291→    "build_sense_check_content_prompt",
   292→    "build_sense_check_structure_prompt",
   293→]
   294→

    11→        f"""
    12→        ## Workflow Guide
    13→
    14→        Work the two loops: **outer** (scan → score → at target? → rescan) and
    15→        **inner** (plan → fix next → update plan → repeat until plan clear).
    16→
    17→        1. **Follow `next`**: `desloppify next` — the single source of truth for what to work on now.
    18→           It is the execution queue from the living plan, surfaces auto-clustered batches,
    19→           and tells you exactly what to do.
    20→           Use `desloppify backlog` only to inspect broader open work outside execution.
    21→        2. **Fix & resolve**: Fix the issue, then:
    22→           `desloppify plan resolve "<id>" --note "<what you did>" --confirm`
    23→           Or with explicit attestation: `--attest "{attest_example}"`
    24→        3. **Plan strategically**: `desloppify plan` / `desloppify plan queue` — reorder,
    25→           cluster related issues, and inspect the execution queue.
    26→           Think about sequencing: what unblocks the most? What cascades? What can be batched?
    27→        4. **Run auto-fixers** (if available): `desloppify autofix <fixer> --dry-run` to preview, then apply.
    28→        5. **Rescan**: `desloppify scan --path <path>` — verify improvements, catch cascading effects.
    29→        6. **Subjective review**: `desloppify review --prepare` then follow your runner's review workflow
    30→           (see skill doc for Codex, Claude, or external paths).
    31→        7. **Triage** (after review): prefer
    32→           `desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner codex` or
    33→           `desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner claude`.
    34→           Manual dashboard/fallback: `desloppify plan triage`.
    35→           Complete all stages (observe → reflect → organize → enrich → sense-check → value-check → commit).
    36→        8. **Check progress**: `desloppify status` — dimension scores dashboard.
    37→
    38→        ### Decision Guide
    39→        - **Tackle**: T1/T2 (high impact), auto-fixable, security issues
    40→        - **Consider skipping**: T4 low-confidence, test/config zone issues (lower impact)
    41→        - **Wontfix**: Intentional patterns, false positives →
    42→          `desloppify plan skip --permanent "<id>" --note "<why>" --attest "{attest_example}"`
    43→        - **Batch wontfix**: Multiple intentional patterns →
    44→          `desloppify plan skip --permanent "<detector>::*::<category>" --note "<why>" --attest "{attest_example}"`
    45→
    46→        ### Understanding Scores
    47→        - **Overall**: 25% mechanical + 75% subjective. Lenient — wontfix doesn't count against you.
    48→        - **Objective**: Mechanical detectors only (no subjective review component).
    49→        - **Strict**: Same as overall, but wontfix items count as open. THIS IS YOUR NORTH STAR.
    50→        - **Verified**: Like strict, but only credits fixes the scanner has confirmed.

   142→def _first_unmet_prerequisite(
   143→    stage_name: str,
   144→    recorded: dict[str, bool],
   145→    confirmed: dict[str, bool],
   146→) -> StagePrerequisite | None:
   147→    for prerequisite in TRIAGE_STAGE_PREREQUISITES[stage_name]:
   148→        if not recorded.get(prerequisite.stage_name, False):
   149→            return prerequisite
   150→        if prerequisite.require_confirmation and not confirmed.get(prerequisite.stage_name, False):
   151→            return prerequisite
   152→    return None

   155→def compute_triage_progress(stages_data: dict) -> TriageProgress:
   156→    """Return canonical triage-stage progression for display and validation."""
   157→    stage_map = stages_data if isinstance(stages_data, dict) else {}
   158→    readiness: list[StageReadiness] = []
   159→    recorded: dict[str, bool] = {}
   160→    confirmed: dict[str, bool] = {}
   161→
   162→    for stage_name, _label in TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS:
   163→        payload = stage_map.get(stage_name, {})
   164→        is_recorded = isinstance(payload, dict) and stage_name in stage_map
   165→        is_confirmed = bool(payload.get("confirmed_at")) if isinstance(payload, dict) else False
   166→        readiness.append(
   167→            StageReadiness(
   168→                name=stage_name,
   169→                recorded=is_recorded,
   170→                confirmed=is_confirmed,
   171→            )
   172→        )
   173→        recorded[stage_name] = is_recorded
   174→        confirmed[stage_name] = is_confirmed
   175→
   176→    current_stage: str | None = None
   177→    blocked_reason: str | None = None
   178→    next_command: str | None = None
   179→
   180→    for stage_name, label in TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS:

   182→            continue
   183→        missing = _first_unmet_prerequisite(stage_name, recorded, confirmed)
   184→        if missing is None:
   185→            current_stage = stage_name
   186→            next_command = triage_manual_stage_command(stage_name)
   187→        else:
   188→            prerequisite_label = _STAGE_LABEL_BY_NAME.get(missing.stage_name, missing.stage_name)
   189→            if missing.require_confirmation and recorded.get(missing.stage_name, False):
   190→                blocked_reason = f"{label} blocked until {prerequisite_label} is confirmed."
   191→                next_command = _confirm_stage_command(missing.stage_name)
   192→            else:
   193→                blocked_reason = f"{label} blocked until {prerequisite_label} is recorded."
   194→                next_command = triage_manual_stage_command(missing.stage_name)
   195→        break

   200→        blocked_reason=blocked_reason,
   201→        next_command=next_command,
   202→        completed_count=sum(1 for stage in readiness if stage.recorded),
   203→        confirmed_count=sum(1 for stage in readiness if stage.confirmed),
   204→    )

   207→def triage_run_stages_command(
   208→    *,
   209→    runner: str = "codex",
   210→    only_stages: str | tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | None = None,
   211→) -> str:
   212→    """Return the canonical staged triage runner command."""
   213→    resolved_runner = str(runner).strip().lower()
   214→    if resolved_runner not in TRIAGE_RUNNERS:
   215→        supported = ", ".join(TRIAGE_RUNNERS)
   216→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported triage runner: {runner!r}. Valid: {supported}")
   217→
   218→    command = f"desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner {resolved_runner}"
   219→    if only_stages is None:
   220→        return command
   221→
   222→    if isinstance(only_stages, str):
   223→        stages = [only_stages]
   224→    else:
   225→        stages = [str(stage).strip().lower() for stage in only_stages if str(stage).strip()]
   226→
   227→    invalid = [stage for stage in stages if stage not in _RUNNER_STAGE_NAMES]
   228→    if invalid:
   229→        supported = ", ".join(sorted(_RUNNER_STAGE_NAMES))
   230→        bad = ", ".join(sorted(set(invalid)))
   231→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported triage stage(s): {bad}. Valid: {supported}")
   232→
   233→    return f"{command} --only-stages {','.join(stages)}"
   234→
   235→
   236→def triage_runner_commands(
   237→    *,
   238→    only_stages: str | tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | None = None,
   239→) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], tuple[str, str]]:
   240→    """Return the preferred staged-runner commands for Codex and Claude."""
   241→    return (
   242→        ("Codex", triage_run_stages_command(runner="codex", only_stages=only_stages)),
   243→        ("Claude", triage_run_stages_command(runner="claude", only_stages=only_stages)),

   247→def triage_manual_stage_command(stage: str) -> str:
   248→    """Return the manual fallback command for a triage stage."""
   249→    resolved_stage = str(stage).strip().lower()
   250→    if resolved_stage not in _MANUAL_STAGE_COMMANDS:
   251→        supported = ", ".join(sorted(_MANUAL_STAGE_COMMANDS))
   252→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported triage stage: {stage!r}. Valid: {supported}")
   253→    return _MANUAL_STAGE_COMMANDS[resolved_stage]
   254→

  "new_string": "def _validate_sense_check_stage(\n    plan: dict,\n    state: dict,\n    repo_root: Path,\n    stages: dict,\n) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Validate recorded sense-check-stage content (includes value decisions).\"\"\"\n    if \"sense-check\" not in stages:\n        return False, \"Sense-check stage not recorded.\"\n    report = stages[\"sense-check\"].get(\"report\", \"\")\n    if len(report) < 100:\n        return False, f\"Sense-check report too short ({len(report)} chars, need 100+).\"\n    if not open_review_ids_from_state(state) and not manual_clusters_with_issues(plan):\n        return True, \"\"\n    failures = run_enrich_quality_checks(\n        plan,\n        repo_root,\n        phase_label=\"sense-check\",\n    )\n    if failures:\n        return False, failures[0].message\n    path_failures = validate_report_has_file_paths(report)\n    blocking_pf = [failure for failure in path_failures if failure.blocking]\n    if blocking_pf:\n        return False, blocking_pf[0].message\n    sc_clusters = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)\n    cluster_failures = validate_report_references_clusters(report, sc_clusters)\n    blocking_cf = [failure for failure in cluster_failures if failure.blocking]\n    if blocking_cf:\n        return False, blocking_cf[0].message\n    # Decision Ledger validation (value subagent output)\n    targets = value_check_targets(plan, state)\n    if targets:\n        parsed = parse_value_check_decision_ledger(report)\n        if not parsed.entries:\n            return False, \"Sense-check report missing `## Decision Ledger` entries.\"\n        if parsed.duplicates:\n            return False, f\"Sense-check report duplicates decision targets: {', '.join(parsed.duplicates[:5])}\"\n        missing = [target for target in targets if target not in parsed.entries]\n        if missing:\n            return False, f\"Sense-check report missing decision(s) for: {', '.join(missing[:5])}\"\n        extras = [target for target in parsed.entries if target not in targets]\n        if extras:\n            return False, f\"Sense-check report references non-live target(s): {', '.join(extras[:5])}\"\n    return True, \"\""
}

code\\n\\n\"\n        \"What can still be worth keeping:\\n\"\n        \"- simplifications that delete layers or reduce branching\\n\"\n        \"- aesthetic cleanups that genuinely improve --permanent <pattern> --note \"<why>\"'\n            ' --attest \"I have reviewed this triage skip against the code and I am not gaming the score'\n            ' by suppressing a real defect.\"`\\n'\n            f\"- `{cli_command} plan cluster delete <name>` if you skipped everything it contained\\n\"\n        )\n        parts.append(commands)\n    else:\n        parts.append(\n            \"## Apply the rubric above, not the raw issue title.\\n\"\n        \"3. Tighten any keeper whose steps are too vague, too broad, or too complicated.\\n\"\n        \"4. Permanently skip anything that fails the value test.\\n\"\n        \"5. Delete dead clusters after skipping all their members.\\n\"\n    )\n    parts.append(process)\n\n    # Include targets\n    parts.append(\"## Live Queue Targets\\n\")\n    for target in targets:\n        if target in clusters:\n            cluster = clusters[target]\n            steps = cluster.get(\"action_steps\", [])\n            parts.append(f\"- **{target}** ({len(steps)} steps)\")\n        else:\n            parts.append(f\"- {target}\")\n\n    # Include cluster details\n    if clusters:\n        parts.append(\"\\n## Cluster Details\\n\")\n        for name, cluster in sorted(clusters.items()):\n            steps = cluster.get(\"action_steps\", [])\n            issues = cluster_issue_ids(cluster)\n            parts.append(f\"### {name} ({len(steps)} steps, {len(issues)} issues)\")\n            for i, step in enumerate(steps, 1):\n                parts.append(_format_cluster_step(i, step))\n\n    output_section = (\n        \"\\n## Output\\n\"\n        \"Start with a `## Decision Ledger` section:\\n\"\n        \"```\\n\"\n        \"## Decision Ledger\\n\"\n        \"- cluster-or-id -> keep\\n\"\n        \"- cluster-or-id -> tighten\\n\"\n        \"- cluster-or-id -> skip\\n\"\n        \"```\\n\"\n        \"Then add short sections explaining the reasoning, with concrete file references.\\n\"\n        \"Cover every live queue target exactly once in the ledger.\\n\"\n    )\n    parts.append(output_section)\n\n    return \"\\n\\n\".join(parts)\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"build_sense_check_content_prompt\",\n    \"build_sense_check_structure_prompt\",\n    \"build_sense_check_value_prompt\",\n]"

  "new_string": "def _value_batch_config(\n    *,\n    plan: dict,\n    state: dict | None,\n    repo_root: Path,\n    prompts_dir: Path,\n    output_dir: Path,\n    logs_dir: Path,\n    mode: str,\n    cli_command: str,\n) -> SenseBatchConfig:\n    prompt = build_sense_check_value_prompt(\n        plan=dict(plan),\n        state=state,\n        repo_root=repo_root,\n        mode=mode,\n        cli_command=cli_command,\n    )\n    return SenseBatchConfig(\n        label=\"value\",\n        prompt_file=prompts_dir / \"sense_check_value.md\",\n        output_file=output_dir / \"sense_check_value.raw.txt\",\n        log_file=logs_dir / \"sense_check_value.log\",\n        prompt=prompt,\n    )\n\n\ndef run_sense_check(\n    *,\n    plan: dict,\n    repo_root: Path,\n    prompts_dir: Path,\n    output_dir: Path,\n    logs_dir: Path,\n    timeout_seconds: int,\n    dry_run: bool = False,\n    cli_command: str = \"desloppify\",\n    apply_updates: bool = False,\n    reload_plan: Callable[[], dict] | None = None,\n    append_run_log=None,\n    state: dict | None = None,\n) -> TriageStageRunResult:\n    \"\"\"Run sense-check via parallel codex subprocess batches (content → structure → value).\"\"\"\n    _log = append_run_log or _noop_log\n\n    clusters = manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)\n    total_content = len(clusters)\n    total = total_content + 2  # +1 structure +1 value\n    _print_sense_header(total_content, apply_updates=apply_updates, log=_log)"

   736→                    "detail": "Update src/foo.ts to remove dead code and fix the pattern. " + "x" * 30,
   737→                    "effort": "small",
   738→                    "issue_refs": ["review::a::b"],
   739→                }
   740→            ],
   741→        }
   742→    }
   743→    ok, msg = validate_stage("sense-check", plan, {}, tmp_path)
   744→    assert ok
   745→
   746→
   747→def test_sense_check_stage_in_pipeline_order() -> None:
   748→    """sense-check and value-check must appear between enrich and commit in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS."""
   749→    from desloppify.engine._plan.constants import TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS
   750→
   751→    ids = list(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS)
   752→    assert "triage::sense-check" in ids
   753→    assert "triage::value-check" in ids
   754→    enrich_idx = ids.index("triage::enrich")
   755→    sense_idx = ids.index("triage::sense-check")
   756→    value_idx = ids.index("triage::value-check")
   757→    commit_idx = ids.index("triage::commit")
   758→    assert enrich_idx < sense_idx < value_idx < commit_idx
   759→
   760→
   761→# ---------- Plan lock ----------
   762→
   763→
   764→def test_plan_lock_prevents_concurrent_writes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
   765→    """plan_lock should serialize access via file locking."""
   766→    import threading
   767→
   768→    from desloppify.engine._plan.persistence import plan_lock
   769→
   770→    plan_file = tmp_path / "plan.json"
   771→    plan_file.write_text("{}")
   772→
   773→    results: list[int] = []
   774→    barrier = threading.Barrier(2)
   775→
   776→    def worker(value: int) -> None:
   777→        barrier.wait()  # ensure both threads start ~simultaneously
   778→        with plan_lock(plan_file):
   779→            # If locking works, only one thread is in here at a time
   780→            current = len(results)
   781→            results.append(value)
   782→            assert len(results) == current + 1  # no interleaving
   783→
   784→    t1 = threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(1,))
   785→    t2 = threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(2,))
   786→    t1.start()
   787→    t2.start()
   788→    t1.join(timeout=5)
   789→    t2.join(timeout=5)

   694→    def test_file_move_with_self_changes(self, tmp_path):
   695→        """Self-changes (import rewrites in the moved file) are applied."""
   696→        src = tmp_path / "a.py"

   709→    def test_file_move_with_importer_changes(self, tmp_path):

   725→    def test_file_move_rollback_on_write_error(self, tmp_path):

   146→            "confidence": "high",
   147→            "summary": "Old issue",
   148→            "detail": {},
   149→            "status": "open",
   150→            "note": None,
   151→            "first_seen": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
   152→            "last_seen": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
   153→            "resolved_at": None,
   154→            "reopen_count": 0,
   155→        }
   156→        state["stats"]["open"] = 1
   157→        diff = merge_scan(
   158→            state, [], MergeScanOptions(lang="python", force_resolve=True)
   159→        )
   160→        assert diff["auto_resolved"] == 0
   161→        assert state["work_items"]["smells::old.py::leftover"]["status"] == "open"
   162→
   163→    @patch.object(merge_mod, "_recompute_stats")
   164→    def test_merge_with_ignore_patterns(self, mock_recompute):
   165→        """Issues matching ignore patterns are suppressed but still counted."""
   166→        mock_recompute.return_value = None
   167→        state = self._make_state()
   168→        issues = [
   169→            {
   170→                "id": "smells::vendor/lib.py::debug",
   171→                "detector": "smells",
   172→                "file": "vendor/lib.py",
   173→                "tier": 2,
   174→                "confidence": "high",
   175→                "summary": "Debug",
   176→                "detail": {},
   177→                "status": "open",
   178→                "note": None,
   179→                "first_seen": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
   180→                "last_seen": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
   181→                "resolved_at": None,
   182→                "reopen_count": 0,
   183→            },
   184→        ]
   185→        diff = merge_scan(
   186→            state,
   187→            issues,
   188→            MergeScanOptions(lang="python", ignore=["vendor/*"]),
   189→        )
   190→        assert diff["ignored"] == 1
   191→        assert diff["raw_issues"] == 1
   192→        # Issue is inserted but suppressed:
   193→        f = state["work_items"]["smells::vendor/lib.py::debug"]
   194→        assert f["suppressed"] is True
   195→
   196→    @patch.object(merge_mod, "_recompute_stats")
   197→    def test_merge_none_options_uses_defaults(self, mock_recompute):
   198→        """Passing options=None still works (uses default MergeScanOptions)."""
   199→        mock_recompute.return_value = None
   200→        state = self._make_state()
   201→        state["stats"]["open"] = 0
   202→        diff = merge_scan(state, [])
   203→        assert diff["new"] == 0
   204→
   205→    @patch.object(merge_mod, "_recompute_stats")
   206→    def test_scan_history_capped_at_20(self, mock_recompute):
   207→        """Scan history is capped at 20 entries."""
   208→        mock_recompute.return_value = None
   209→        state = self._make_state()
   210→        state["stats"]["open"] = 0
   211→        # Pre-fill 20 entries
   212→        state["scan_history"] = [{"timestamp": f"t{i}"} for i in range(20)]
   213→        merge_scan(state, [], MergeScanOptions(lang="python"))
   214→        assert len(state["scan_history"]) == 20

   646→class TestRollbackMoveTarget:
   647→    def test_no_rollback_when_conditions_not_met(self, tmp_path):
   648→        """No rollback if dest doesn't exist or source still exists."""
   649→        source = str(tmp_path / "source.py")
   650→        dest = str(tmp_path / "dest.py")
   651→        # Neither exists
   652→        move_apply_mod._rollback_move_target(dest, source, target_name="file")
   653→        # Source still exists
   654→        Path(source).write_text("content")
   655→        Path(dest).write_text("content")
   656→        move_apply_mod._rollback_move_target(dest, source, target_name="file")
   657→        assert Path(source).exists()
   658→        assert Path(dest).exists()
   659→
   660→    def test_rollback_moves_dest_back_to_source(self, tmp_path):
   661→        dest = tmp_path / "dest.py"
   662→        source = tmp_path / "source.py"
   663→        dest.write_text("moved content")
   664→        # source should not exist
   665→        assert not source.exists()
   666→        move_apply_mod._rollback_move_target(str(dest), str(source), target_name="file")
   667→        assert source.exists()
   668→        assert source.read_text() == "moved content"
   669→
   670→    @patch("desloppify.app.commands.move.apply.shutil.move", side_effect=OSError("fail"))
   671→    @patch("desloppify.app.commands.move.apply.warn_best_effort")
   672→    def test_rollback_os_error_warns(self, mock_warn, mock_move, tmp_path):
   673→        dest = tmp_path / "dest.py"
   674→        dest.write_text("content")
   675→        source = tmp_path / "source.py"
   676→        # Dest exists and source doesn't -- should attempt rollback
   677→        move_apply_mod._rollback_move_target(str(dest), str(source), target_name="file")
   678→        mock_warn.assert_called_once()

   682→class TestApplyFileMove:
   683→    def test_file_move_basic(self, tmp_path):
   684→        """Basic file move with no self/importer changes."""
   685→        src = tmp_path / "a.py"
   686→        dest = tmp_path / "b.py"
   687→        src.write_text("original content")
   688→
   689→        move_apply_mod.apply_file_move(str(src), str(dest), {}, [])
   690→        assert not src.exists()
   691→        assert dest.exists()
   692→        assert dest.read_text() == "original content"
   693→
   694→    def test_file_move_with_self_changes(self, tmp_path):
   695→        """Self-changes (import rewrites in the moved file) are applied."""
   696→        src = tmp_path / "a.py"
   697→        dest = tmp_path / "sub" / "a.py"
   698→        src.write_text("from foo import bar")
   699→
   700→        move_apply_mod.apply_file_move(
   701→            str(src),
   702→            str(dest),
   703→            {},
   704→            [("from foo import bar", "from baz import bar")],
   705→        )
   706→        assert dest.exists()
   707→        assert dest.read_text() == "from baz import bar"
   708→
   709→    def test_file_move_with_importer_changes(self, tmp_path):
   710→        """Importers that reference the moved file get rewritten."""
   711→        src = tmp_path / "a.py"
   712→        dest = tmp_path / "b.py"
   713→        importer = tmp_path / "user.py"
   714→        src.write_text("pass")
   715→        importer.write_text("from a import thing")
   716→
   717→        move_apply_mod.apply_file_move(
   718→            str(src),
   719→            str(dest),
   720→            {str(importer): [("from a import thing", "from b import thing")]},
   721→            [],
   722→        )
   723→        assert importer.read_text() == "from b import thing"
   724→
   725→    def test_file_move_rollback_on_write_error(self, tmp_path):
   726→        """If writing an importer fails, the move is rolled back."""
   727→        src = tmp_path / "a.py"
   728→        dest = tmp_path / "b.py"
   729→        src.write_text("pass")
   730→
   731→        # Pass an importer that will fail during write (dir path used as file)
   732→        bad_importer = str(tmp_path / "nonexistent_dir" / "deep" / "file.py")
   733→        # Create a Path that won't be readable:
   734→        with pytest.raises((OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, shutil.Error)):
   735→            move_apply_mod.apply_file_move(
   736→                str(src),
   737→                str(dest),
   738→                {bad_importer: [("old", "new")]},
   739→                [],
   740→            )

   109→    return (

   130→def _active_cluster_issue_ids(plan: dict | None) -> set[str]:
   131→    """Return issue IDs owned by clusters that are active planned work."""
   132→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   133→        return set()
   134→    active_ids: set[str] = set()
   135→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   136→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   137→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict) or not cluster_is_active(cluster):
   138→            continue
   139→        for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
   140→            if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id and issue_id not in skipped_ids:
   141→                active_ids.add(issue_id)
   142→    return active_ids
   143→

   145→def _merge_execution_candidates(
   146→    *,
   147→    all_issue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   148→    explicit_objective_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   149→    plan: dict | None,
   150→    review_issue_ids: set[str],
   151→    assessment_request_ids: set[str],
   152→) -> tuple[list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   153→    """Merge queue-owned execution items with objective defaults."""
   154→    explicit_queue_ids = _live_planned_queue_ids(plan)
   155→    active_cluster_ids = _active_cluster_issue_ids(plan)
   156→
   157→    queued_non_review_items = [
   158→        item
   159→        for item in all_issue_items
   160→        if item.get("id", "") in explicit_queue_ids
   161→        and item.get("id", "") not in assessment_request_ids
   162→        and (
   163→            item.get("id", "") not in review_issue_ids
   164→            or item.get("id", "") in active_cluster_ids
   165→        )
   166→    ]
   167→
   168→    execution_candidates: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   169→    seen_execution_ids: set[str] = set()
   170→    for item in [*explicit_objective_items, *queued_non_review_items]:
   171→        item_id = str(item.get("id", ""))
   172→        if not item_id or item_id in seen_execution_ids:
   173→            continue
   174→        seen_execution_ids.add(item_id)
   175→        execution_candidates.append(item)
   176→
   177→    anchored_execution_items = [
   178→        item
   179→        for item in execution_candidates
   180→        if item.get("id", "") in explicit_queue_ids
   181→    ]
   182→    return execution_candidates, anchored_execution_items
   183→
   184→
   185→def _executable_review_issue_items(
   186→    plan: dict | None,
   187→    state: StateModel,
   188→    review_issue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   189→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   190→    """Hide raw review findings until triage is current for the live issue set."""
   191→    if not review_issue_items or not isinstance(plan, dict):
   192→        return review_issue_items
   193→
   194→    triage_snapshot = build_triage_snapshot(plan, state)
   195→    if triage_snapshot.has_triage_in_queue:
   196→        return []
   197→    if triage_snapshot.is_triage_stale:
   198→        return []
   199→    if not triage_snapshot.triage_has_run:
   200→        return []
   201→    return review_issue_items
